questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Who among the following was the founder of the Kadamba dynasty of Banavasi?
questions.text_alt: ಬನವಾಸಿಯ ಕದಂಬ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನವರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Mayurasharma (c. 345–365 CE) founded the Kadamba dynasty of Banavasi after subduing the Pallavas, as recorded in the Talagunda pillar inscription.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The famous Aihole Inscription which records the achievements of Pulakeshin II was composed by which court poet?
questions.text_alt: ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ ಪುಲಕೇಶಿಯ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಐಹೊಳೆ ಶಾಸನವನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿದ ಆಸ್ಥಾನ ಕವಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: The Aihole inscription (634 CE) at the Meguti Jain temple was composed in Sanskrit by the Jain court poet Ravikirti.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The earliest extant Kannada literary work 'Kavirajamarga' is attributed to which Rashtrakuta king?
questions.text_alt: ಕನ್ನಡದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಲಭ್ಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಕೃತಿ 'ಕವಿರಾಜಮಾರ್ಗ' ಯಾವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಕೂಟ ದೊರೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: Kavirajamarga (c. 850 CE) was written during the reign of Rashtrakuta monarch Amoghavarsha I (with court poet Sri Vijaya contributing to its creation).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Hoysala ruler built the magnificent Chennakeshava Temple at Belur to commemorate his victory over the Cholas in the Battle of Talakad?
questions.text_alt: ತಲಕಾಡು ಕದನದಲ್ಲಿ ಚೋಳರ ಮೇಲಿನ ವಿಜಯದ ಸ್ಮರಣಾರ್ಥ ಬೇಲೂರಿನ ಚೆನ್ನಕೇಶವ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ದೊರೆ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Hoysala king Vishnuvardhana built the Vijayanarayana (Chennakeshava) temple at Belur in 1117 CE after capturing Talakad from the Cholas.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: In which year was the historic Battle of Talikota (Rakkasa-Tangadi) fought, leading to the collapse of the Vijayanagara Empire?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಪತನಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾದ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ತಾಳಿಕೋಟೆ ಕಾಳಗ (ರಕ್ಕಸ-ತಂಗಡಿಗಿ) ಯಾವ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Talikota was fought on January 23, 1565, between the Vijayanagara army under Aliya Rama Raya and the combined Deccan Sultanates.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Kittur Rani Chennamma led an armed rebellion against British East India Company rule in 1824 following the death of which British Collector of Dharwad?
questions.text_alt: 1824 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ರಾಣಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಸಿದ ದಂಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಡಿದ ಧಾರವಾಡದ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಕಲೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: St. John Thackeray, Political Agent and Collector of Dharwad, was killed on October 23, 1824, when Kittur forces resisted British annexation under the Doctrine of Lapse.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which historic event that occurred in Chikkaballapura district on 25 April 1938 is commemorated as the 'Jallianwala Bagh of Karnataka'?
questions.text_alt: 1938 ರ ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 25 ರಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಯಾವ ಘಟನೆಯನ್ನು 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜಲಿಯನ್ ವಾಲಾ ಬಾಗ್' ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: At Vidurashwatha on 25 April 1938, police opened fire on peaceful Congress satyagrahis gathered to unfurl the National Flag, killing over 10 people.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Who authored the influential book 'Karnataka Gathavaibhava' (1917), which sparked the Karnataka Unification (Ekikarana) movement?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಏಕೀಕರಣ ಚಳವಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಗತವೈಭವ' (1917) ಕೃತಿಯ ಕರ್ತೃ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Aluru Venkata Rao is revered as 'Karnataka Kulapurohita' for his seminal book 'Karnataka Gathavaibhava' which rekindled pride in Karnataka's glorious past.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which is the highest geographical peak in Karnataka?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ ಶಿಖರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Mullayanagiri in the Chandra Drona / Baba Budangiri range of Chikkamagaluru district is the highest peak in Karnataka with an altitude of 1,930 metres (6,332 ft).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The famous Jog Falls (Gersoppa Falls) in Shivamogga district is created by which river?
questions.text_alt: ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಜೋಗ ಜಲಪಾತ (ಗೇರುಸೊಪ್ಪೆ) ಯಾವ ನದಿಯಿಂದ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಗೊಂಡಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls on the Sharavathi River drops 253 metres (830 ft) across four distinct cascades: Raja, Roarer, Rocket, and Rani.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which mountain pass (Ghat) in the Western Ghats connects Mangaluru with Sakleshpur and Hassan?
questions.text_alt: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಗಳೂರನ್ನು ಸಕಲೇಶಪುರ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುವ ಘಾಟಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Shiradi Ghat (NH 75) connects Mangaluru with Hassan/Sakleshpur; Charmadi Ghat connects Mangaluru with Mudigere/Chikkamagaluru.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which bird sanctuary in Mandya district was declared as Karnataka's first Ramsar Wetland Site of International Importance in 2022?
questions.text_alt: 2022 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಪ್ರಥಮ ರಾಮ್ಸರ್ ಜೌಗು ಪ್ರದೇಶವೆಂದು ಘೋಷಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಮಂಡ್ಯ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಪಕ್ಷಿಧಾಮ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary along the Cauvery River in Mandya district was designated as Karnataka's 1st Ramsar site in August 2022.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the 'Right to Constitutional Remedies', described by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?
questions.text_alt: ಡಾ. ಬಿ. ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರು ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 'ಹೃದಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮ' ಎಂದು ಕರೆದ 'ಸಾಂವಿಧಾನಿಕ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳ ಹಕ್ಕು' ಭಾರತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಯಾವ ವಿಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: Article 32 confers the right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Under which Constitutional Amendment Act was Article 21A (Right to Free and Compulsory Education) inserted into the Indian Constitution?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಕ್ಕೆ 21ಎ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನು (ಉಚಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಹಕ್ಕು) ಯಾವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002, inserted Article 21A, making education a Fundamental Right for children aged 6 to 14 years.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Article of the Indian Constitution grants special provisions and reservations in education and public employment for the Kalyana Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka) region?
questions.text_alt: ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ (ಹೈದರಾಬಾದ್-ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ) ಪ್ರದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ವಿಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Article 371J was inserted by the 98th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2012, providing special provisions for the six backward districts of Kalyana Karnataka.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which writ is issued by a High Court or Supreme Court to quash an illegal order passed by a lower court or quasi-judicial tribunal lacking jurisdiction?
questions.text_alt: ಕೆಳ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಅಥವಾ ನ್ಯಾಯಮಂಡಳಿ ತನ್ನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಮೀರಿ ಹೊರಡಿಸಿದ ಕಾನೂನುಬಾಹಿರ ಆದೇಶವನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಹೊರಡಿಸುವ ರಿಟ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Certiorari is a corrective writ issued to quash the order of an inferior court or tribunal made without or in excess of jurisdiction.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) in the Indian Constitution were borrowed from the constitution of which country?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಭಾಗ IV ರಲ್ಲಿರುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಕ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾವ ದೇಶದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದಿಂದ ಎರವಲು ಪಡೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles of State Policy (Articles 36–51) were inspired by the Irish Constitution of 1937 (which in turn borrowed from Spain).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the minimum qualifying age for an Indian citizen to be elected as a Member of the Lok Sabha?
questions.text_alt: ಲೋಕಸಭೆಯ ಸದಸ್ಯರಾಗಿ (ಎಂಪಿ) ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾಗಲು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪ್ರಜೆಗೆ ಇರಬೇಕಾದ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವಯಸ್ಸು ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Under Article 84(b), the minimum age for election to the Lok Sabha is 25 years (and 30 years for the Rajya Sabha).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The Shivanasamudra Hydro-electric Project established on the Cauvery River in 1902 was primarily built to supply electricity to which location?
questions.text_alt: 1902 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾದ ಶಿವನಸಮುದ್ರ ಜಲವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಯಾವ ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಪೂರೈಸಲು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Commissioned during the reign of Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV, the Shivanasamudra plant was designed to power the gold mines of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: On which historic date was the newly unified state of Mysore officially rechristened as 'Karnataka'?
questions.text_alt: ಏಕೀಕೃತ ಮೈಸೂರು ರಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ' ಎಂದು ಮರುನಾಮಕರಣ ಮಾಡಿದ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Under the Chief Ministership of D. Devaraj Urs, the state of Mysore was officially renamed 'Karnataka' on 1 November 1973.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Under the Karnataka Government's flagship 'Gruha Lakshmi' scheme, what is the monthly financial assistance provided to the woman head of eligible households?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಯ 'ಗೃಹಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ' ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ಅರ್ಹ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಯಜಮಾನಿಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Gruha Lakshmi provides ₹2,000 per month directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the woman head of eligible households.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: What benefit is guaranteed to women domiciled in Karnataka under the 'Shakti' scheme launched by the Karnataka State Government?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತಂದಿರುವ 'ಶಕ್ತಿ' ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ದೊರೆಯುವ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Free bus travel in state-run road transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC)

options.label: C
options.text: Free health insurance coverage up to ₹5 Lakhs

options.label: D
options.text: Subsidized electric scooters for working women

questions.explanation: The Shakti scheme provides free bus travel for women domiciled in Karnataka in non-premium services across all 4 state transport corporations.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Under the Karnataka Government's 'Yuva Nidhi' guarantee scheme, what monthly unemployment allowance is provided to eligible unemployed graduates?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ 'ಯುವನಿಧಿ' ಖಾತರಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುವ ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗ ಭತ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Yuva Nidhi provides ₹3,000 per month to unemployed degree graduates and ₹1,500 per month to unemployed diploma holders for up to two years.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: What is the official name given to the landing site of ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 lunar lander 'Vikram' on the Moon's south pole?
questions.text_alt: ಇಸ್ರೋದ ಚಂದ್ರಯಾನ-3 ನೌಕೆಯ 'ವಿಕ್ರಮ್' ಲ್ಯಾಂಡರ್ ಚಂದ್ರನ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಧ್ರುವದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಳಿದ ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ಇಡಲಾದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಹೆಸರೇನು?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi designated the Chandrayaan-3 touchdown site as 'Shiv Shakti Point' and August 23 as 'National Space Day'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: At which Lagrange Point is ISRO's solar observatory satellite 'Aditya-L1' stationed to continuously monitor the Sun without eclipses?
questions.text_alt: ಯಾವುದೇ ಗ್ರಹಣಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸೂರ್ಯನನ್ನು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಇಸ್ರೋದ 'ಆದಿತ್ಯ-ಎಲ್1' ಸೌರ ವೀಕ್ಷಣಾಲಯವನ್ನು ಯಾವ ಲ್ಯากรಾಂಜ್ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: L1 (Lagrange Point 1, ~1.5 million km from Earth)

questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 is placed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 1 (L1), located approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which came into enforcement in July 2024, replaced which historic penal statute?
questions.text_alt: ಜುಲೈ 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಭಾರತೀಯ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಂಹಿತೆ (BNS) ಯಾವ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕಾನೂನನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced the colonial Indian Penal Code 1860; BNSS replaced CrPC 1973; BSA replaced Evidence Act 1872.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Who among the following was awarded the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2024 in recognition of his role as the architect of India's Green Revolution?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತದ ಹಸಿರು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯ ಪಿತಾಮಹ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾದ ಯಾರಿಗೆ 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮರಣೋತ್ತರವಾಗಿ 'ಭಾರತ ರತ್ನ' ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿ ಗೌರವಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Dr. M. S. Swaminathan was posthumously conferred the Bharat Ratna in 2024 alongside Karpoori Thakur, P. V. Narasimha Rao, and Chaudhary Charan Singh.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Who was honoured with the prestigious 58th Jnanpith Award (for the year 2023, conferred in 2024)?
questions.text_alt: ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ 58ನೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಗೆ (2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರದಾನ ಮಾಡಲಾದ) ಜಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಭಾಜನರಾದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: The Jnanpith Selection Committee conferred the 58th Jnanpith Award jointly on Urdu poet/filmmaker Gulzar and Sanskrit scholar Jagadguru Rambhadracharya.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Which Indian shooter made history by winning two Olympic bronze medals at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games in the same edition?
questions.text_alt: ಪ್ಯಾರಿಸ್ 2024 ಒಲಿಂಪಿಕ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಕಂಚಿನ ಪದಕಗಳನ್ನು ಗೆದ್ದು ಇತಿಹಾಸ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ ಭಾರತದ ಶೂಟರ್ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Manu Bhaker won bronze in Women's 10m Air Pistol and another bronze in Mixed 10m Air Pistol team event with Sarabjot Singh at Paris 2024.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Which national team emerged champions of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 held in the West Indies and USA?
questions.text_alt: ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಇಂಡೀಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಯುಎಸ್ಎ ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಐಸಿಸಿ ಪುರುಷರ ಟಿ20 ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ 2024 ಚಾಂಪಿಯನ್ ಆದ ದೇಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: India defeated South Africa by 7 runs in the final at Kensington Oval, Barbados, on June 29, 2024, to lift their second T20 World Cup trophy.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Which international multilateral organization was formally inducted as a permanent member of the G20 during India's G20 Presidency at the New Delhi Summit?
questions.text_alt: ನವದೆಹಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಜಿ20 ಶೃಂಗಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜಿ20 ಕೂಟದ ಖಾಯಂ ಸದಸ್ಯನಾಗಿ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆಗೊಂಡ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The 55-nation African Union (AU) was admitted as a permanent member of the G20 at the New Delhi G20 Leaders' Summit in September 2023.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: What is the maximum free domestic electricity consumption allowed per month per household under Karnataka's 'Gruha Jyothi' guarantee scheme?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ 'ಗೃಹಜ್ಯೋತಿ' ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಎಷ್ಟು ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಗೃಹಬಳಕೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Gruha Jyothi provides up to 200 units of free electricity per month based on the household's average monthly consumption plus a 10% allowance.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Which new Ramsar Wetland site from Karnataka was added to the Ramsar List in 2024, located in the estuary of Uttara Kannada district?
questions.text_alt: 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಮ್ಸರ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದ ಉತ್ತರ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ನದೀಮುಖಜ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜೌಗು ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Aghanashini Estuary in Uttara Kannada was declared a Ramsar Wetland of International Importance in January 2024 along with Magadi Kere and Ankasamudra.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: The 2024 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Nihon Hidankyo, a grassroots movement representing atomic bomb survivors from which nation?
questions.text_alt: ಪರಮಾಣು ಬಾಂಬ್ ದಾಳಿಯ ಸಂತ್ರಸ್ತರ ಜಪಾನಿನ 'ನಿಹೋನ್ ಹಿಡಾಂಕ್ಯೋ' ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ 2024 ರ ಯಾವ ನೊಬೆಲ್ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಯಿತು?

options.label: D
options.text: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

questions.explanation: Nihon Hidankyo (Japan) was awarded the 2024 Nobel Peace Prize for its efforts to achieve a world free of nuclear weapons.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.text: Who among the following was conferred the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2022 (presented in 2024)?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗದ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ 'ದಾದಾಸಾಹೇಬ್ ಫಾಲ್ಕೆ' ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು (2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದ) ಪಡೆದ ಹಿರಿಯ ನಟ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Veteran actor and politician Mithun Chakraborty was conferred the 70th National Film Awards' Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.text_alt: How many letters are there in the standard Kannada Varnamale?
questions.explanation: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು 49 ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿವೆ (14 ಸ್ವರಗಳು + 2 ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳು + 33 ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳು).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'ಐ' ಮತ್ತು 'ಔ' ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.text_alt: In Kannada Varnamale, what are 'Ai' and 'Au' classified as?
questions.explanation: ಎರಡು ಸ್ವರಗಳು ಕೂಡಿ ಆಗಿರುವ 'ಐ' ಮತ್ತು 'ಔ' ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು 'ಸಂಧ್ಯಾಕ್ಷರಗಳು' ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ವರ್ಗೀಯ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗದ ಐದನೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು (ಙ, ಞ, ಣ, ನ, ಮ) ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.text_alt: What are the 5th letters of each consonant group called?
questions.explanation: ಮೂಗಿನ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ವರ್ಗದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿಗೆ 'ಅನುನಾಸಿಕಗಳು' ಎನ್ನಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಊರೂರು' ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: The compound word 'Ururu' (Uru + Uru) is an example of which Sandhi?
questions.explanation: ಊರು + ಊರು = ಊರೂರು (ಪೂರ್ವಪದದ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಉ' ಸ್ವರವು ಲೋಪವಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಲೋಪಸಂಧಿ).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಮಳೆಗಾಲ' ಪದವನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ ಬರೆದಾಗ ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which Sandhi is formed in 'Malegala' (Male + Kala)?
questions.explanation: ಮಳೆ + ಕಾಲ = ಮಳೆಗಾಲ. ಉತ್ತರಪದದ ಆದಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕ' ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ 'ಗ' ಕಾರ ಆದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಆದೇಶ ಸಂಧಿ.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯ' (ಸೂರ್ಯ + ಉದಯ) ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which Sanskrit Sandhi is 'Suryodaya' an example of?
questions.explanation: ಅ/ಆ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಇ/ಈ ಪರವಾದರೆ 'ಏ', ಉ/ಊ ಪರವಾದರೆ 'ಓ', ಋ ಪರವಾದರೆ 'ಅರ್' ಬರುವುದು ಗುಣಸಂಧಿ (ಸೂರ್ಯ + ಉದಯ = ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯ).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ' (ಇತಿ + ಆದಿ) ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which Sandhi is 'Ityadi' (Iti + Adi)?
questions.explanation: ಇ, ಈ, ಉ, ಊ, ಋ ಗಳಿಗೆ ಸವರ್ಣವಲ್ಲದ ಸ್ವರ ಪರವಾದರೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಯ್, ವ್, ರ್ ಗಳು ಬರುವುದು ಯಣ್ ಸಂಧಿ (ಇತಿ + ಆದಿ = ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಹೆಮ್ಮರ' (ಹಿರಿದು + ಮರ) ಎಂಬುದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which Samasa is 'Hemmara' (Hiridu + Mara)?
questions.explanation: ವಿಶೇಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷ್ಯಗಳು ಸೇರಿ ಆಗುವ ಸಮಾಸವನ್ನು 'ಕರ್ಮಧಾರಯ ಸಮಾಸ' ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ (ಹಿರಿದಾದ ಮರ = ಹೆಮ್ಮರ).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಪಂಚವಟಿ' (ಐದು ವಟಗಳ ಸಮೂಹ) ಎಂಬುದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸ?
questions.text_alt: Which Samasa is 'Panchavati'?
questions.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ವಾಚಕವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದು 'ದ್ವಿಗು ಸಮಾಸ'.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಮುಕ್ಕಣ್ಣ' (ಮೂರು ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳುಳ್ಳವನು - ಶಿವ) ಎಂಬ ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which Samasa is 'Mukkanna' (Shiva)?
questions.explanation: ಸಮಸ್ತಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೊಂದು ಮೂರನೆಯ ಪದದ ಅರ್ಥವು (ಅನ್ಯಪದಾರ್ಥ) ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದು 'ಬಹುವ್ರೀಹಿ ಸಮಾಸ'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೃತೀಯಾ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: What is the Karaka of Triteeya Vibhakti?
questions.explanation: ಪ್ರಥಮಾ: ಕರ್ತೃ, ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾ: ಕರ್ಮ, ತೃತೀಯಾ: ಕರಣ (ಸಾಧನ - 'ಇಂದ'), ಚತುರ್ಥಿ: ಸಂಪ್ರದಾನ, ಪಂಚಮೀ: ಅಪಾದಾನ, ಷಷ್ಠೀ: ಸಂಬಂಧ, ಸಪ್ತಮೀ: ಅಧಿಕರಣ.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಕೃತ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರಿ ನಾಮಪದವಾದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.text_alt: What is a noun formed by adding a Krit suffix to a verbal root called?
questions.explanation: ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಕೃತ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಪದ 'ಕೃದಂತ ನಾಮ' (ಉದಾ: ಮಾಡು + ಅವನು = ಮಾಡಿದವನು).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಮಾಟಗಾತಿ' (ಮಾಟ + ಗಾತಿ) ಎಂಬುದು ಯಾವ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.text_alt: What grammatical category is 'Matagaati'?
questions.explanation: ನಾಮಪ್ರಕೃತಿಗೆ ತದ್ಧಿತ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರಿದಾಗ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಪದ 'ತದ್ಧಿತಾಂತ ನಾಮ' (ಮಾಟ + ಗಾತಿ = ಮಾಟಗಾತಿ).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ವರ್ಷ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: What is the Tadbhava form of the Tatsama word 'Varsha'?
questions.explanation: ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತದ 'ವರ್ಷ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಕನ್ನಡ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ವರುಷ'.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: What is the Tadbhava of 'Lakshmi'?
questions.explanation: 'ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ' ತತ್ಸಮದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ಲಕುಮಿ'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಅಕ್ಷರ' ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: What is the Tadbhava of 'Akshara'?
questions.explanation: 'ಅಕ್ಷರ' ತತ್ಸಮದ ಕನ್ನಡ ತದ್ಭವ 'ಅಕ್ಕರ'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಉಪಮೇಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಮಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಭೇದವನ್ನು (ಯಾವುದೇ ಭೇದವಿಲ್ಲವೆಂದು) ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿ ಹೇಳುವ ಅಲಂಕಾರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: Which Alankara states complete non-difference between Upameya and Upamana?
questions.explanation: ಉಪಮೇಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಮಾನಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಎರಡೂ ಒಂದೇ ಎಂದು ವರ್ಣಿಸುವುದು 'ರೂಪಕಾಲಂಕಾರ'.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಷಟ್ಪದಿ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ 'ಭಾಮಿನಿ ಷಟ್ಪದಿ'ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪಾದದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳ ನಿಯಮವೇನು?
questions.text_alt: What is the matra rule in Bhamini Shatpadi?

options.label: A
options.text: 3, 4, 3, 4 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು (1 ಮತ್ತು 2 ನೇ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ 14 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು, 3 ನೇ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ 23 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು)

questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ವಾರ್ಧಕ ಷಟ್ಪದಿ'ಯ ಪಾದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಗಣಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.text_alt: What matra gana pattern is found in Vardhaka Shatpadi?
questions.explanation: ವಾರ್ಧಕ ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 5 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳ ಗಣಗಳು ಬರುತ್ತವೆ (1, 2, 4, 5 ಪಾದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 4 ಪಂಚಮಾತ್ರಾಗಣಗಳು = 20 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು; 3, 6 ಪಾದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 6 ಪಂಚಮಾತ್ರಾಗಣಗಳು + 1 ಗುರು = 32 ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಅತ್ತೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ, ಸೊಸೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ' ಎಂಬ ಗಾದೆ ಮಾತಿನ ಒಳಾರ್ಥವೇನು?
questions.text_alt: What is the inner meaning of the Kannada proverb 'Attegondu kaala, sosegondu kaala'?

options.label: B
options.text: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುವ ಕಾಲ ಅಥವಾ ಅವಕಾಶ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ

questions.explanation: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯ, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಲು ಕಾಲಾವಕಾಶ ಒದಗಿಬರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಇದರ ಆಶಯ.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಕರ್ತೃವಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಧಾನ್ಯ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಹೇಳುವ ಪ್ರಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.text_alt: What is the active voice called in Kannada grammar?
questions.explanation: ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದದ ರೂಪವು ಕರ್ತೃವಿನ ಲಿಂಗ, ವಚನ, ಪುರುಷಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ ಬಂದರೆ ಅದು 'ಕರ್ತರಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ' (Active Voice).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಯಾವ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.text_alt: Which suffix is added to verbal root in Karmani Prayoga?
questions.explanation: ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಾಧಾನ್ಯವಿದ್ದು, ಧಾತುವಿನ ಮುಂದೆ 'ಪಡು' ರೂಪ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ (ಉದಾ: ರಾವಣನು ರಾಮನಿಂದ ಕೊಲ್ಲಲ್ಪಟ್ಟನು).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಅಮೃತ' ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.text_alt: What is the antonym of 'Amruta'?
questions.explanation: ಅಮೃತ ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ 'ವಿಷ' (ಅಥವಾ ಗರಳ).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಚಂದ್ರ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕವಲ್ಲದ ಪದವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.text_alt: Identify the word that is NOT a synonym for Chandrama/Moon:
questions.explanation: 'ಭಾಸ್ಕರ' ಎಂದರೆ ಸೂರ್ಯ. ಶಶಿ, ತಿಂಗಳು, ಸೋಮ, ಇಂದು ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದಗಳು.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.text: 'ಕುಂಬಾರನಿಗೆ ವರುಷ, ದಣ್ಣೆಗೊಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ' ಎಂಬ ಗಾದೆ ಮಾತು ಯಾವುದನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.text_alt: What does the proverb 'Kumbaranige varusha, dannegondu nimisha' signify?

options.label: B
options.text: ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲ ಬೇಕು, ಆದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡಲು ಕೇವಲ ಕ್ಷಣಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಕು

options.label: D
options.text: ಕುಂಬಾರ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಡಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ

questions.explanation: ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ವರ್ಷಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಶ್ರಮ ಬೇಕು, ಆದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡಲು ಕ್ಷಣ ಸಾಕು ಎಂಬುದು ಇದರ ನೀತಿ.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form: 'The sun _____ in the east.'
questions.text_alt: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಾಲರೂಪವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ಭರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿ: 'The sun _____ in the east.'
questions.explanation: Universal truths and habitual actions take Simple Present Tense with third-person singular suffix '-s'/' -es' ('rises').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Complete the sentence: 'She has been studying in this school _____ five years.'
questions.text_alt: ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ: 'She has been studying in this school _____ five years.'
questions.explanation: 'For' is used to denote a duration/period of time ('for five years'), whereas 'since' denotes a specific starting point.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Identify the passive voice form of: 'The teacher praised the honest student.'
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ: 'The teacher praised the honest student.'

options.label: A
options.text: The honest student was praised by the teacher.

options.label: B
options.text: The honest student is praised by the teacher.

options.label: C
options.text: The honest student had been praised by the teacher.

options.label: D
options.text: The honest student praised the teacher.

questions.explanation: Simple past active ('praised') changes into 'was/were + past participle' in the passive voice ('was praised by the teacher').
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the correct indirect speech form of: He said, 'I have finished my homework.'
questions.text_alt: ಪರೋಕ್ಷ ಕಥನ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ: He said, 'I have finished my homework.'

options.label: A
options.text: He said that he has finished his homework.

options.label: B
options.text: He said that he had finished his homework.

options.label: C
options.text: He said that he finished his homework.

options.label: D
options.text: He told that he had finished his homework.

questions.explanation: In indirect speech with past reporting verb ('said'), Present Perfect ('have finished') shifts back to Past Perfect ('had finished').
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'He is proficient _____ computer programming.'
questions.text_alt: ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದ ಪ್ರಿಪೊಸಿಷನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ: 'He is proficient _____ computer programming.'
questions.explanation: The adjective 'proficient' takes the preposition 'in' when referring to a field, language, or subject.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the correct preposition: 'The principal congratulated the students _____ their outstanding performance.'
questions.text_alt: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರಿಪೊಸಿಷನ್ ಆರಿಸಿ: 'The principal congratulated the students _____ their outstanding performance.'
questions.explanation: 'Congratulate' is followed by the preposition 'on' (congratulate someone on something).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate article: 'He is _____ European citizen residing in Karnataka.'
questions.text_alt: ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದ ಉಪಪದವನ್ನು (article) ಆರಿಸಿ: 'He is _____ European citizen residing in Karnataka.'
questions.explanation: Although 'European' begins with vowel letter 'E', it begins with the consonant glide sound /j/ (yu-), requiring indefinite article 'a'.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: 'Copper is _____ useful metal.'
questions.text_alt: ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗವನ್ನು ಭರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿ: 'Copper is _____ useful metal.'
questions.explanation: 'Useful' begins with the consonant sound /juː/ ('yoo'), so it takes 'a', not 'an'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Select the option with correct Subject-Verb Agreement: 'Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present in the auditorium.'
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ತೃ-ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಿರುವ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees in number with the nearer subject ('students' is plural -> 'were').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Complete the conditional clause: 'If it rains tomorrow, we _____ the picnic.'
questions.text_alt: ಷರತ್ತುಬದ್ಧ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ: 'If it rains tomorrow, we _____ the picnic.'
questions.explanation: First conditional (real present/future possibility): 'If + Simple Present (rains)' takes 'will + base verb (will cancel)' in the main clause.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Identify the grammatically correct sentence:
questions.text_alt: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:

options.label: A
options.text: Scarcely had I entered the room when the lights went off.

options.label: B
options.text: Scarcely had I entered the room than the lights went off.

options.label: C
options.text: No sooner had I entered the room when the lights went off.

options.label: D
options.text: Hardly had I entered the room than the lights went off.

questions.explanation: 'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' correlate with 'when', while 'No sooner' correlates with 'than'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What is the synonym of the word 'BENEVOLENT'?
questions.text_alt: 'BENEVOLENT' ಪದದ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning, kindly, and charitable ('Generous and kind').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What is the antonym of the word 'CANDID'?
questions.text_alt: 'CANDID' ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and frank. Its opposite is 'deceitful' or secretive.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What is the meaning of the idiom 'To burn the midnight oil'?
questions.text_alt: 'To burn the midnight oil' ಎಂಬ ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟಿನ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?

options.label: B
options.text: To work or study late into the night

options.label: D
options.text: To sleep soundly through the night

questions.explanation: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to work hard late into the night (especially studying or preparing).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What does the idiom 'A blessing in disguise' mean?
questions.text_alt: 'A blessing in disguise' ನುಡಿಗಟ್ಟಿನ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: A curse delivered by a holy man

options.label: B
options.text: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in good outcome

questions.explanation: A blessing in disguise refers to an unfortunate event that seemed bad initially but turned out to produce positive results.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.text_alt: ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಾಗುಣಿತವಿರುವ (spelled) ಪದವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Accommodate' with double 'c' and double 'm'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.text_alt: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಾಗುಣಿತವಿರುವ ಪದವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Maintenance'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Spot the error in the sentence: 'One of the student (A) / was selected (B) / for the national award (C) / No error (D)'
questions.text_alt: ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿನ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ ದೋಷವಿರುವ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: The phrase 'one of the...' must be followed by a plural noun ('One of the students', not 'student').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the one-word substitution for: 'A person who looks at the bright, hopeful side of things.'
questions.text_alt: ಒಂದೇ ಪದದ ಬದಲಿ ಪದವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ: 'A person who looks at the bright side.'
questions.explanation: An 'optimist' is a person inclined to be hopeful and expect favorable outcomes.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Choose the one-word substitution for: 'An autobiography is the life history of a person written by _____.'
questions.text_alt: ಖಾಲಿ ಜಾಗವನ್ನು ಭರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿ: 'An autobiography is written by _____.'
questions.explanation: An autobiography is an account of a person's life written by that person.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate question tag: 'She sings melodiously, _____?'
questions.text_alt: ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಥಕ ಟ್ಯಾಗ್ (question tag) ಆರಿಸಿ: 'She sings melodiously, _____?'
questions.explanation: Positive statement in Simple Present ('sings') takes negative auxiliary question tag 'doesn't she?'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate question tag: 'Let us begin the session, _____?'
questions.text_alt: ಸೂಕ್ತವಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾರ್ಥಕ ಟ್ಯಾಗ್ ಆರಿಸಿ: 'Let us begin the session, _____?'
questions.explanation: Suggestions beginning with 'Let us' or 'Let's' conventionally take the tag 'shall we?'.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What is the plural form of the noun 'Criterion'?
questions.text_alt: 'Criterion' ನಾಮಪದದ ಬಹುವಚನ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'Criterion' (Greek origin) forms its plural as 'Criteria'.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: What is the feminine gender form of 'Bachelor'?
questions.text_alt: 'Bachelor' ಪದದ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The feminine counterpart of bachelor (unmarried man) is spinster or bachelorette.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General English
questions.text: Identify the figure of speech in: 'The classroom was a zoo during the lunch break.'
questions.text_alt: ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅಲಂಕಾರವನ್ನು (figure of speech) ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: A direct comparison equating two different entities without using 'like' or 'as' is a Metaphor.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: According to Jean Piaget, at which cognitive developmental stage does a child achieve 'Object Permanence'?
questions.text_alt: ಜೀನ್ ಪಿಯಾಜೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಮಗು ಯಾವ ಜ್ಞಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಕಾಸದ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ 'ವಸ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿರತೆ'ಯನ್ನು (Object Permanence) ಸಾಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Object permanence emerges around 8–9 months of age during the Sensorimotor stage (0–2 years).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: A child in Piaget's Pre-Operational stage who believes that the sun follows them when they walk is demonstrating which cognitive characteristic?
questions.text_alt: ತಾನು ನಡೆಯುವಾಗ ಸೂರ್ಯನೂ ತನ್ನನ್ನೇ ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂದು ನಂಬುವ ಮಗುವಿನ ಈ ವರ್ತನೆಯು ಪಿಯಾಜೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಯಾವುದನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Pre-operational children exhibit Egocentrism (assuming the world revolves around their perspective) and Animism (attributing consciousness to inanimate objects).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: According to Piaget, modifying existing mental schemas or creating brand new schemas when confronted with conflicting experiences is termed:
questions.text_alt: ಹೊಸ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾರ್ಪಡಿಸುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಪಿಯಾಜೆ ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: Assimilation fits new data into old schemas; Accommodation modifies or creates new schemas when old schemas fail.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Lev Vygotsky defined the distance between what a child can do independently and what they can achieve with guidance as:
questions.text_alt: ಮಗು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಬಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರರ ನೆರವಿನಿಂದ ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯದ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ವೈಗೋಟ್ಸ್ಕಿ ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: The Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) is the range of tasks a learner cannot yet perform alone but can accomplish with scaffolding from an MKO.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Who coined the instructional term 'Scaffolding' to describe temporary teacher support that is gradually removed as the child gains mastery?
questions.text_alt: ಕಲಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡುವ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಬೆಂಬಲವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ 'ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾಫೋಲ್ಡಿಂಗ್' (ಹಂದರ ಒದಗಿಸುವಿಕೆ) ಪದವನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ಬಳಸಿದವರು ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: The term 'Scaffolding' was coined by Jerome Bruner, David Wood, and Gail Ross (1976) and operationalized within Vygotsky's ZPD framework.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Which developmental progression represents Jerome Bruner's Three Modes of Representation in correct chronological sequence?
questions.text_alt: ಜೆರೋಮ್ ಬ್ರೂನರ್ ಅವರ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಪ್ರಾತಿನಿಧಿಕ ಹಂತಗಳ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಅನುಕ್ರಮ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Bruner posited: 1. Enactive (action-based, 0–1 yr), 2. Iconic (image-based, 1–6 yrs), 3. Symbolic (language/code-based, 7+ yrs).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Which Primary Law of Learning formulated by E. L. Thorndike states that connections are strengthened when followed by satisfaction/reward and weakened when followed by discomfort?
questions.text_alt: ತೃಪ್ತಿದಾಯಕ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಬಲಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಇ. ಎಲ್. ಥಾರ್ನ್‌ಡೈಕ್ ಅವರ ನಿಯಮ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Thorndike's Law of Effect established that responses followed by satisfying consequences are more likely to recur, directly anticipating operant conditioning.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: In B. F. Skinner's Operant Conditioning, which reinforcement schedule produces the highest rate of responses and the greatest resistance to extinction?
questions.text_alt: ಬಿ. ಎಫ್. ಸ್ಕಿನ್ನರ್ ಅವರ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಅನುಬಂಧನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯಾ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ಅಳಿಸಿಹೋಗುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Variable Ratio (VR) schedule (exemplified by gambling/slot machines) reinforces after unpredictable numbers of responses, yielding intense persistence.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: In Ivan Pavlov's classical experiment with dogs, what was the Conditioned Stimulus (CS)?
questions.text_alt: ಇವಾನ್ ಪಾವ್ಲೋವ್ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಅನುಬಂಧಿತ ಉದ್ದೀಪನ' (CS) ಯಾವುದಾಗಿತ್ತು?
questions.explanation: Food is Unconditioned Stimulus (UCS); Bell initially is Neutral Stimulus (NS), and after repeated pairing becomes the Conditioned Stimulus (CS).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: What are the four essential sub-processes of Observational Learning identified in Albert Bandura's Social Cognitive Theory?
questions.text_alt: ಆಲ್ಬರ್ಟ್ ಬಂಡೂರ ಅವರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಹಂತಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.explanation: Bandura specified: 1. Attention (observing), 2. Retention (memorizing), 3. Reproduction (motor execution), 4. Motivation (incentive/reinforcement).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Wolfgang Köhler's famous experiment with Sultan the chimpanzee using bamboo sticks to reach bananas demonstrated which form of learning?
questions.text_alt: ಚಿಂಪಾಂಜಿ ಸುಲ್ತಾನ್ ಮೇಲೆ ವುಲ್ಫ್‌ಗ್ಯಾಂಗ್ ಕೊಹ್ಲರ್ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಪ್ರಯೋಗವು ಯಾವ ಬಗೆಯ ಕಲಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸಿತು?
questions.explanation: Köhler showed that problem-solving occurs through sudden cognitive restructuring of the perceptual whole, termed Insight Learning (Aha! experience).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Howard Gardner proposed the Multiple Intelligences theory. Which of the following is NOT one of Gardner's original multiple intelligences?
questions.text_alt: ಹೋವರ್ಡ್ ಗಾರ್ಡ್ನರ್ ಅವರ ಬಹುಮುಖಿ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದು ಸೇರಿಲ್ಲ?
questions.explanation: Gardner explicitly rejected Charles Spearman's unitary general factor ('g-factor') in favor of 8+ independent modular intelligences.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: In Robert Sternberg's Triarchic Theory of Intelligence, what are the three sub-theories of intelligence?
questions.text_alt: ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಸ್ಟರ್ನ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ಅವರ ತ್ರಿಮುಖ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಮೂರು ವಿಧಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.explanation: Sternberg's Triarchic Theory comprises: 1. Analytical (Componential), 2. Creative (Experiential), and 3. Practical (Contextual) intelligences.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: What is the standard formula for calculating the Intelligence Quotient (IQ) developed by William Stern and adopted by Lewis Terman?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಲಿಯಂ ಸ್ಟರ್ನ್ ನೀಡಿದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಲಬ್ಧಿ (IQ) ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವ ಸೂತ್ರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: IQ = (Mental Age / Chronological Age) * 100.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: According to Terman's Stanford-Binet IQ classification, what is the IQ score range for an individual categorized as having 'Average / Normal' intelligence?
questions.text_alt: ಟರ್ಮನ್ ಅವರ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ 'ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ / ಸರಾಸರಿ' ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಐಕ್ಯೂ (IQ) ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: An IQ score between 90 and 109 represents Average or Normal intelligence (spanning approximately 50% of the human population).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: In Sigmund Freud's psychoanalytic model of personality, which structural component operates strictly on the 'Reality Principle' as an executive mediator?
questions.text_alt: ಸಿಗ್ಮಂಡ್ ಫ್ರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಅವರ ಮನೋವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣಾ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ 'ವಾಸ್ತವತೆಯ ತತ್ವ'ದ (Reality Principle) ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಅಂಗ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Ego operates on the Reality Principle, mediating realistic compromises between primal demands of the Id and moral ideals of the Superego.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: A student who fails an examination and makes excuses by blaming the strict evaluator ('The paper was out of syllabus; teacher hates me') is using which ego defense mechanism?
questions.text_alt: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುತ್ತೀರ್ಣನಾದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯು 'ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಕಠಿಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು, ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪಕರಿಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಕಂಡರೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ' ಎಂದು ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಯಾವ ಮನೋರಕ್ಷಣಾ ತಂತ್ರ?
questions.explanation: Rationalization involves creating plausible, socially acceptable excuses to justify failure and preserve self-esteem (popularly known as 'sour grapes').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: A child suffering from severe difficulty with reading fluency, letter reversals (confusing 'b' and 'd'), and word decoding is characterized by which specific learning disorder?
questions.text_alt: ಓದುವಿಕೆ, ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೀವ್ರ ತೊಂದರೆ ('b' ಮತ್ತು 'd' ಗೊಂದಲ) ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ಮಗುವಿನ ಕಲಿಕಾ ನ್ಯೂನತೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Dyslexia is a specific learning disability characterized by difficulties with accurate and fluent word recognition, decoding, and spelling.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016, how many categories of disabilities are officially recognized in India?
questions.text_alt: ಭಿಕಲಾಂಗ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ (RPwD Act) 2016 ರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾದ ಅಂಗವೈಕಲ್ಯಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: The RPwD Act 2016 expanded the number of recognized benchmark disabilities from 7 (under the 1995 Act) to 21 categories.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: What is the primary objective of Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE) in school education?
questions.text_alt: ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರಂತರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಗ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನದ (CCE) ಮುಖ್ಯ ಉದ್ದೇಶವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: To classify students into pass and fail categories strictly

options.label: B
options.text: To evaluate both scholastic and co-scholastic holistic development of the child

options.label: C
options.text: To reduce the number of working days for teachers

options.label: D
options.text: To emphasize only end-of-year pen-and-paper tests

questions.explanation: CCE aims to cover all aspects of child growth: scholastic (cognitive) and co-scholastic (affective, psychomotor, life skills, values).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: Assessment conducted 'during' the teaching-learning process to diagnose learning gaps and adapt instructional methods is termed:
questions.text_alt: ಕಲಿಕಾ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗಲೇ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಕೊರತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಲು ಮತ್ತು ಬೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ನಡೆಸುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Formative assessment is 'Assessment for Learning', carried out during instruction to provide continuous pedagogical feedback.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: If a test produces consistent and stable scores across repeated administrations to the same cohort under identical conditions, the test possesses high:
questions.text_alt: ಒಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಸಿದಾಗ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ ಅಂಕಗಳು ಬಂದರೆ, ಆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು ಏನನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ ಎನ್ನಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Reliability is the degree of consistency and repeatability of test scores. (Validity measures whether the test measures what it claims to measure).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: In the Revised Bloom's Taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001), which is the highest cognitive process dimension?
questions.text_alt: ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಬ್ಲೂಮ್ಸ್ ಜ್ಞಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಶ್ರೇಣೀಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ (2001) ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ಹಂತ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The revised hierarchy is: Remember -> Understand -> Apply -> Analyze -> Evaluate -> Create (highest level).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: The flat horizontal portion of a learning curve that indicates no visible improvement in performance despite ongoing practice is called a:
questions.text_alt: ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮುಂದುವರಿದಿದ್ದರೂ ಕಲಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ಗೋಚರ ಪ್ರಗತಿ ಕಾಣದಿರುವ ಕಲಿಕಾ ರೇಖೆಯ ಸಮತಟ್ಟಾದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: A Learning Plateau occurs when progress stalls due to fatigue, loss of interest, reaching limits of current strategy, or physiological ceiling.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.text: At which level of Abraham Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs does an individual strive to realize their fullest creative human potential?
questions.text_alt: ಅಬ್ರಹಾಂ ಮಾಸ್ಲೋ ಅವರ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳ ಶ್ರೇಣೀಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಬಯಸುವ ಉನ್ನತ ಹಂತ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Self-Actualization is the pinnacle growth need where a person seeks fulfillment of personal potential, self-fulfillment, and peak experiences.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which of the following is considered the 'Brain' of a computer system that performs all arithmetic and logical operations?
questions.text_alt: ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಮತ್ತು ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ನ 'ಮೆದುಳು' ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Central Processing Unit (CPU), comprising the ALU and Control Unit, executes program instructions.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which type of computer memory is volatile, losing all its stored contents when the electric power is turned off?
questions.text_alt: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸ್ಥಗಿತಗೊಂಡಾಗ ತನ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಅಸ್ಥಿರ (Volatile) ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile primary memory requiring constant electrical power to maintain stored data.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: What is the primary function of high-speed Cache Memory positioned between the CPU and main RAM?
questions.text_alt: ಸಿಪಿಯು ಮತ್ತು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮೆಮೊರಿ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಹೈ-ಸ್ಪೀಡ್ ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಮೆಮೊರಿಯ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: To permanently store operating system installation files

options.label: B
options.text: To bridge the speed disparity between fast CPU registers and slower RAM

options.label: C
options.text: To protect the computer from network viruses

questions.explanation: Cache memory holds frequently accessed instructions and data to minimize memory latency.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: In Microsoft Word, which keyboard shortcut is used to 'Paste' copied or cut text from the clipboard?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ವರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿದ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅಂಟಿಸಲು (Paste) ಬಳಸುವ ಕೀಬೋರ್ಡ್ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + C copies, Ctrl + X cuts, and Ctrl + V pastes from the clipboard.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which feature in Microsoft Word is used to generate personalized letters, certificates, or envelopes in bulk from a single data source table?
questions.text_alt: ಒಂದೇ ಮೂಲ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ನೂರಾರು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಪತ್ರಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಮುದ್ರಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಎಂಎಸ್ ವರ್ಡ್ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Mail Merge merges a template document with a data source (e.g., an Excel sheet or Access database) to produce customized bulk letters.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: In Microsoft Excel, every formula or calculation MUST begin with which character?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಎಕ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಸೂತ್ರವು (formula) ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಾಗಿ ಯಾವ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗಬೇಕು?
questions.explanation: Excel interprets an entry as a formula only if it begins with an equals sign ('=').
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: In Microsoft Excel, how is an Absolute Cell Reference denoted to prevent cell coordinates from changing during formula autofill?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಎಕ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಕಾಪಿ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಕೋಶದ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬದಲಾಗದಂತೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತಗೊಳಿಸಲು (Absolute Cell Reference) ಯಾವ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: The dollar sign '$' locks the column and row (e.g., `$A$1` keeps both column A and row 1 absolute when copied).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which function key is pressed in Microsoft PowerPoint to launch the full-screen Slide Show from the beginning?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಪವರ್‌ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಸ್ಲೈಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಸ್ಲೈಡ್ ಶೋ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಫಂಕ್ಷನ್ ಕೀ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: F5 starts the presentation from Slide 1; Shift + F5 starts from the currently active slide.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which standardized Kannada software and font engine was officially adopted and distributed by the Government of Karnataka?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ಅಂಗೀಕರಿಸಿ ವಿತರಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಕನ್ನಡ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Nudi was developed by the Kannada Ganaka Parishat and officially adopted by the Government of Karnataka for administrative Kannada word processing.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: What is the standard keyboard toggle shortcut used in Nudi software to switch between English and Kannada typing mode?
questions.text_alt: ನುಡಿ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕನ್ನಡ ಟೈಪಿಂಗ್ ನಡುವೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಕೀಲಿ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: In standard Nudi direct typing mode, pressing 'Scroll Lock' toggles Kannada phonetic typing on and off.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: How many bits constitute a single Byte in modern digital computing?
questions.text_alt: ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬೈಟ್ (Byte) ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ (Bits) ಸಮನಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: 8 bits make 1 byte. 4 bits make 1 nibble.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which of the following is an open-source, multi-user, multitasking operating system?
questions.text_alt: ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಮೂಲದ (Open Source), ಬಹು-ಬಳಕೆದಾರ ಆಪರೇಟಿಂಗ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಂ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Linux is a free and open-source operating system kernel created by Linus Torvalds.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: What does the 'S' stand for in the secure web address protocol 'HTTPS'?
questions.text_alt: ವೆಬ್ ವಿಳಾಸದಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'HTTPS' ನಲ್ಲಿ 'S' ಅಕ್ಷರದ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?
questions.explanation: HTTPS stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure, encrypting transmission via Transport Layer Security (TLS).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: The fraudulent practice of sending deceptive emails purporting to be from reputable banks to steal user credentials is known as:
questions.text_alt: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕುಗಳ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಕಲಿ ಇಮೇಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಕದಿಯುವ ಸೈಬರ್ ವಂಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: Phishing is a social engineering cyberattack designed to trick users into disclosing sensitive information.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Malicious software that encrypts a victim's files and demands payment in cryptocurrency to restore access is termed:
questions.text_alt: ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಎನ್‌ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುವ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ransomware (such as WannaCry) extorts payments by holding user data hostage under encryption.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: What is the primary function of an input device?
questions.text_alt: ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸಾಧನದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: To feed raw data and instructions into the computer system

options.label: B
options.text: To print processed output on paper

questions.explanation: Input devices (keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone) convert external data into digital signals readable by the CPU.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which keyboard shortcut is used in Microsoft Windows to undo the most recent action?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಂಡೋಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊನೆಯದಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಲು (Undo) ಬಳಸುವ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + Z undoes the previous action; Ctrl + Y redoes it.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: What is the purpose of the Domain Name System (DNS) on the internet?
questions.text_alt: ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಡೊಮೇನ್ ನೇಮ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್‌ನ (DNS) ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: Translating human-readable domain names (like www.google.com) into numerical IP addresses

questions.explanation: DNS acts as the phonebook of the internet, mapping hostnames to IP addresses.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: Which Indian Act enacted in 2000 provides the legal framework for electronic governance, digital signatures, and cybercrimes?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈಬರ್ ಅಪರಾಧಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಸಹಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾನೂನು ಚೌಕಟ್ಟು ಒದಗಿಸುವ 2000 ರ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Information Technology Act, 2000 (amended in 2008) is the primary law in India dealing with cybercrime and electronic commerce.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.text: In Microsoft PowerPoint, what is the term used to describe the visual effect that occurs when one slide moves to the next during a slide show?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಪವರ್‌ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸ್ಲೈಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸ್ಲೈಡ್‌ಗೆ ಚಲಿಸುವಾಗ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ದೃಶ್ಯ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: Transitions control the motion between slides; Animations control motion of individual elements on a slide.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: The deficiency of Vitamin C in human diet causes which of the following diseases?
questions.text_alt: ಮಾನವನ ಆಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಸಿ' ವಿಟಮಿನ್ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) deficiency causes Scurvy, leading to bleeding gums and skin spots.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Night blindness (Nyctalopia) and Xerophthalmia are caused by the nutritional deficiency of:
questions.text_alt: ಇರುಳುಗಣ್ಣು ರೋಗವು ಯಾವ ಜೀವಸತ್ವದ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A (Retinol) is essential for rhodopsin synthesis in the retina; its deficiency causes night blindness.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Severe protein deficiency in infants and young children results in which clinical nutritional disorder characterized by swollen belly and edema?
questions.text_alt: ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮಕ್ಕಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ, ಊದಿಕೊಂಡ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ಲಕ್ಷಣವಿರುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕಾಂಶದ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Kwashiorkor is caused by severe protein deficiency; Marasmus is caused by total calorie and protein starvation.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Which mineral is essential for the synthesis of thyroid hormones (Thyroxine), the deficiency of which causes Goitre?
questions.text_alt: ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನ್ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯವಾದ, ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಗಳಗಂಡ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುವ ಖನಿಜ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Iodine is critical for thyroxine hormone synthesis in the thyroid gland; deficiency causes simple goitre.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Which of the following is a waterborne bacterial disease transmitted through contaminated food and drinking water?
questions.text_alt: ಕಲುಷಿತ ನೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಆಹಾರದಿಂದ ಹರಡುವ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ ರೋಗ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Cholera is caused by the bacterium Vibrio cholerae and spreads through contaminated water.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Malaria is caused by the protozoan parasite Plasmodium and is transmitted to humans by the bite of:
questions.text_alt: ಮಲೇರಿಯಾ ರೋಗವನ್ನು ಹರಡುವ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Female Anopheles mosquitoes transmit Plasmodium parasites causing malaria.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: What does the first-aid acronym 'R.I.C.E.' stand for in the immediate management of acute soft-tissue sprains and muscle strains?
questions.text_alt: ಸ್ನಾಯು ಉಳುಕುಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'R.I.C.E.' ನ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ರೂಪವೇನು?
questions.explanation: RICE protocol: Rest the injured limb, Ice application, Compression bandage, and Elevation above heart level.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: In Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) guidelines for an adult in cardiac arrest, what is the recommended ratio of chest compressions to rescue breaths?
questions.text_alt: ವಯಸ್ಕರ ಸಿಪಿಆರ್ (CPR) ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎದೆ ಒತ್ತಡ ಮತ್ತು ಕೃತಕ ಉಸಿರಾಟದ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಲಾದ ಅನುಪಾತ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Standard AHA CPR guidelines recommend 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths (30:2 ratio).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: On which date is International Yoga Day celebrated globally every year?
questions.text_alt: ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಯೋಗ ದಿನವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿವರ್ಷ ಯಾವ ದಿನಾಂಕದಂದು ಆಚರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: The United Nations General Assembly declared 21 June as International Day of Yoga in 2014.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.text: Which component of food acts as the primary immediate source of energy for the human body during cellular respiration?
questions.text_alt: ಮಾನವ ದೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಷಣದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are broken down into glucose, the primary cellular fuel producing ATP energy.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: In Lawrence Kohlberg's Theory of Moral Development, an individual who obeys rules solely to avoid physical punishment is operating at:
questions.text_alt: ಲಾರೆನ್ಸ್ ಕೋಲ್ಬರ್ಗ್ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಕೇವಲ ದೈಹಿಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಯಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ನೈತಿಕ ಹಂತ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Stage 1: Punishment and Obedience Orientation (Pre-Conventional Level)

options.label: B
options.text: Stage 3: Good Boy / Nice Girl Orientation

questions.explanation: Stage 1 of the Pre-Conventional level evaluates morality strictly by physical consequences: obedience to authority to escape punishment.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Which moral dilemma was famously used by Lawrence Kohlberg in his interviews to assess the moral reasoning of adolescents?
questions.text_alt: ಕೋಲ್ಬರ್ಗ್ ತನ್ನ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೈತಿಕ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಬಳಸಿದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ನೈತಿಕ ಸಂದಿಗ್ಧತೆ (Dilemma) ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: The Heinz Dilemma (stealing drug to save dying wife)

questions.explanation: The Heinz Dilemma asks whether a man named Heinz should steal an overpriced drug to save his dying wife.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: According to Jean Piaget's Theory of Moral Development, what characterizes the stage of 'Heteronomous Morality' (Moral Realism, ages 4–7)?
questions.text_alt: ಜೀನ್ ಪಿಯಾಜೆ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ 'ಪರಾಯತ್ತ ನೈತಿಕತೆ'ಯ (Heteronomous Morality) ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಲಕ್ಷಣವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: Rules are social agreements that can be altered by mutual consensus

options.label: B
options.text: Rules are sacred, immutable decrees of God/adults, and belief in Immanent Justice

options.label: C
options.text: Moral decisions are based on abstract ethical justice principles

options.label: D
options.text: Complete rejection of all authority figures

questions.explanation: Heteronomous morality views rules as unalterable absolutes handed down by authority, accompanied by belief in immanent justice.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Carol Gilligan critiqued Kohlberg's moral development model as male-biased and proposed that women's moral reasoning centers on an:
questions.text_alt: ಕೋಲ್ಬರ್ಗ್ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವನ್ನು ವಿಮರ್ಶಿಸಿದ ಕ್ಯಾರೋಲ್ ಗಿಲ್ಲಿಗನ್, ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ನೈತಿಕತೆಯು ಯಾವುದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರಿತವಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದರು?

options.label: B
options.text: Ethic of Care, Relationships, and Responsibility

questions.explanation: In 'In a Different Voice' (1982), Gilligan showed that women prioritize care, empathy, and maintaining human connections over abstract rules of justice.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Under Section 17 of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which of the following is STRICTLY prohibited in all Indian schools?
questions.text_alt: ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಹಕ್ಕು ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2009 ರ ಕಲಂ 17 ರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ನಿಷೇಧಿಸಲಾಗಿರುವುದು ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: B
options.text: Inflicting physical punishment or mental harassment on children

questions.explanation: Section 17 bans physical punishment and mental harassment, making violators subject to disciplinary action.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Under Section 19 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, what is the mandatory legal duty of a school teacher who gains knowledge of sexual abuse of a student?
questions.text_alt: ಪೋಕ್ಸೊ (POCSO) ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2012 ರ ಕಲಂ 19 ರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Must report the offence immediately to the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) or local police

options.label: B
options.text: Settle the dispute quietly with the student's family

options.label: C
options.text: Wait for final annual school examination results

options.label: D
options.text: Dismiss the student from the school rolls

questions.explanation: Section 19 makes reporting mandatory; Section 21 penalizes failure to report with imprisonment up to one year.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: According to the NCTE Code of Professional Ethics for School Teachers, which of the following practices is considered UNETHICAL?
questions.text_alt: ಎನ್‌ಸಿಟಿಇ (NCTE) ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ನೀತಿ ಸಂಹಿತೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದು ಅನೈತಿಕ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: Treating students of all communities with equality and dignity

options.label: B
options.text: Engaging in private paid tuition for enrolled students for personal commercial gain

options.label: C
options.text: Participating in continuous teacher training programs

questions.explanation: The NCTE code explicitly bars teachers from undertaking commercial private coaching or soliciting monetary benefits from students.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Which Fundamental Duty under Article 51A of the Constitution of India enjoins citizens to develop the 'scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform'?
questions.text_alt: 'ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಮನೋಭಾವ, ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಧಾರಣಾ ಮನೋಭಾವ'ವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಯಾವ ವಿಧಿಯ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: Article 51A(h) directs every Indian citizen to develop the scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Inculcating moral and social values through regular school subjects (history, literature, science) and school assemblies rather than separate lectures is called the:
questions.text_alt: ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಬೋಧನೆಯ ಬದಲು ನಿಯಮಿತ ಪಠ್ಯವಿಷಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನಾ ಸಭೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: The Integrated (Indirect) Approach infuses values seamlessly across existing curricula, co-curricular activities, and the hidden curriculum.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.text: Which four core values are solemnized in the Preamble to the Constitution of India?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಲಾದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಆದರ್ಶ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?

options.label: A
options.text: Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity (ನ್ಯಾಯ, ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ, ಸಮಾನತೆ, ಭ್ರಾತೃತ್ವ)

questions.explanation: The Preamble secures to all citizens: JUSTICE (Social, Economic, Political), LIBERTY, EQUALITY, and FRATERNITY.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The magnificent monolithic rock-cut Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (Cave 16) was excavated during the reign of which Rashtrakuta monarch?
questions.text_alt: ಎಲ್ಲೋರಾದ ಭವ್ಯ ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ಕೈಲಾಸನಾಥ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು (ಗುಹೆ 16) ಯಾವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಕೂಟ ದೊರೆಯ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Rashtrakuta king Krishna I (756–774 CE) commissioned the monolithic rock-cut Kailasa temple at Ellora, carved top-to-bottom from a single basalt cliff.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which ancient capital city was founded by Pulakeshin I as the seat of the Early Chalukya dynasty in 543 CE?
questions.text_alt: ಕ್ರಿ.ಶ. 543 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ರಾಜಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿ ಒಂದನೇ ಪುಲಕೇಶಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ನಗರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Pulakeshin I established his capital at Vatapi (modern Badami in Bagalkote district) and performed the Ashvamedha sacrifice to assert sovereign power.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The world-famous 57-foot monolithic statue of Lord Gommateshwara (Bahubali) at Shravanabelagola was consecrated in 981 CE by which Western Ganga prime minister?
questions.text_alt: ಶ್ರವಣಬೆಳಗೊಳದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ 57 ಅಡಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಗೊಮ್ಮಟೇಶ್ವರ ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ವಿಗ್ರಹವನ್ನು ಕ್ರಿ.ಶ. 981 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆತ್ತಿಸಿ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಾಪಿಸಿದ ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಗಂಗರ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Chavundaraya, military commander and prime minister to Ganga king Rachamalla IV, consecrated the Gommateshwara colossus atop Vindhyagiri hill in 981 CE.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The twin-temple Hoysaleshwara temple at Halebidu, famous for its intricate soapstone relief friezes, was dedicated to Lord Shiva during the reign of which king?
questions.text_alt: ಸೋಪಸ್ಟೋನ್ ಶಿಲ್ಪಕಲೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರಾದ ಹಳೇಬೀಡಿನ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳೇಶ್ವರ ಜೋಡಿ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು ಯಾವ ರಾಜನ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: The Hoysaleshwara temple at Halebidu (Dorasamudra) was initiated under King Vishnuvardhana around 1121 CE by his noble Ketamalla and chief architect Kedaroja.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The Vijayanagara monarch Krishnadevaraya authored which classical political treatise in Telugu describing statecraft and kingly duties?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಜಯನಗರದ ಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮ ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣದೇವರಾಯರು ರಾಜಧರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಆಡಳಿತವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ತೆಲುಗು ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿದರು?
questions.explanation: Krishnadevaraya authored 'Amuktamalyada' in Telugu celebrating Andal's life and detailing statecraft, while his Sanskrit works include 'Jambavati Kalyanam'.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Gol Gumbaz in Vijayapura, famous for its unsupported dome and acoustical Whispering Gallery, is the mausoleum of which Adil Shahi sultan?
questions.text_alt: ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ಎರಡನೇ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುಮ್ಮಟ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರತಿಧ್ವನಿ ದ್ವಾರ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವಿಜಯಪುರದ ಗೋಲ್ ಗುಂಬಜ್ ಯಾವ ಆದಿಲ್ ಶಾಹಿ ಸುಲ್ತಾನನ ಸಮಾಧಿಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: Constructed in 1656 CE by master architect Yaqut of Dabul, Gol Gumbaz houses the mortal remains of Mohammed Adil Shah.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which Mysore ruler established the royal tradition of celebrating the grand Mysore Dasara festival at Srirangapatna in 1610 CE?
questions.text_alt: ಕ್ರಿ.ಶ. 1610 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದ್ಧೂರಿ ಮೈಸೂರು ದಸರಾ ಮಹೋತ್ಸವದ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯವನ್ನು ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಒಡೆಯರ್ ದೊರೆ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Raja Wodeyar I seized Srirangapatna from the Vijayanagara viceroy Tirumala in 1610 and decreed that the Navaratri / Dasara festival be celebrated annually with royal grandeur.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Under the Treaty of Seringapatam (1792) that ended the Third Anglo-Mysore War, Tipu Sultan ceded which territory to the British East India Company?
questions.text_alt: ಮೂರನೇ ಆಂಗ್ಲೋ-ಮೈಸೂರು ಯುದ್ಧವನ್ನು ಕೊನೆಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ (1792) ಅನ್ವಯ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಸುಲ್ತಾನ್ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರಿಗೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Lord Cornwallis forced Tipu Sultan to surrender half his kingdom (including Malabar coast, Coorg protectorate, Dindigul, and Baramahal) and pay 3 crore rupees in indemnity.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The heroic freedom fighter Sangolli Rayanna, who continued armed guerrilla warfare after the fall of Kittur, was captured through betrayal and hanged at:
questions.text_alt: ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ಪತನದ ನಂತರವೂ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಗೆರಿಲ್ಲಾ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿದ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿವೀರ ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಗಲ್ಲಿಗೇರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Sangolli Rayanna was captured by British treacherous machinations and hanged from a banyan tree at Nandagad in Belagavi district on 26 January 1831.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The armed rebellion of the Bedas of Halagali in Mudhol state against British rule in November 1857 was provoked by which oppressive legislation?
questions.text_alt: 1857 ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಧೋಳ ಸಂಸ್ಥಾನದ ಹಲಗಲಿ ಬೇಡರು ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಸಶಸ್ತ್ರ ದಂಗೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾದ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Disarming Act of 1857 required all Indians to surrender their traditional weapons and firearms; the hunting martial Bedas of Halagali heroically refused and revolted.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The unified state of Mysore was officially renamed as 'Karnataka' on 1 November 1973 under the tenure of which Chief Minister?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಶಾಲ ಮೈಸೂರು ರಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು 1973 ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1 ರಂದು ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ' ಎಂದು ಮರುನಾಮಕರಣ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮುಖ್ಯಮಂತ್ರಿ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs spearheaded the historic legislative declaration on November 1, 1973, renaming Mysore State to Karnataka.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What is the total coastline length of Karnataka stretching along the Arabian Sea from Karwar to Mangaluru?
questions.text_alt: ಕಾರವಾರದಿಂದ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನವರೆಗೆ ಅರಬ್ಬಿ ಸಮುದ್ರದ ತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿರುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕರಾವಳಿ ತೀರದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉದ್ದ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Karnataka's coastal belt (Karavali / Canara) stretches approximately 320 km across three coastal districts: Uttara Kannada, Udupi, and Dakshina Kannada.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a right-bank tributary of the Krishna river flowing through Karnataka?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿಯುವ ಕೃಷ್ಣಾ ನದಿಯ ಬಲದಂಡೆಯ ಉಪನದಿಯಲ್ಲದ ನದಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Bhima is the major left-bank tributary of Krishna; Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, and Tungabhadra are right-bank tributaries.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Donimalai and Sandur hill ranges in Ballari district are world-famous for their high-grade reserves of:
questions.text_alt: ಬಳ್ಳಾರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ದೋಣಿಮಲೈ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಡೂರು ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳು ಯಾವ ಉತ್ತಮ ದರ್ಜೆಯ ಅದಿರಿನ ನಿಕ್ಷೇಪಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿವೆ?
questions.explanation: The Sandur-Hospete-Ballari mineral belt possesses abundant rich reserves of high-grade hematite iron ore (NMDC operates Donimalai iron mines).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Which National Park in Karnataka, situated across Mysuru and Kodagu districts, is also designated as the Rajiv Gandhi National Park?
questions.text_alt: ಮೈಸೂರು ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಡಗು ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿರುವ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜೀವ್ ಗಾಂಧಿ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನವನವೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲ್ಪಡುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Nagarahole National Park was renamed Rajiv Gandhi National Park in 1992 and forms a core part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Which three words were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976?
questions.text_alt: 1976 ರ 42 ನೇ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಭಾರತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವನೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾದ ಮೂರು ಪದಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment Act (1976) amended the Preamble to change 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' to 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic' and added 'and integrity'.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Supreme Court of India held that the Right to Privacy is an intrinsic part of the Right to Life and Personal Liberty under Article 21 in which landmark verdict?
questions.text_alt: ಖಾಸಗಿತನದ ಹಕ್ಕು (Right to Privacy) 21 ನೇ ವಿಧಿಯಡಿ ಜೀವಿಸುವ ಹಕ್ಕಿನ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಭಾಗವೆಂದು ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ ಕೋರ್ಟ್ ಯಾವ ಮಹತ್ವದ ತೀರ್ಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎತ್ತಿಹಿಡಿಯಿತು?

options.label: A
options.text: Justice K. S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017)

options.label: B
options.text: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)

options.label: C
options.text: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978)

options.label: D
options.text: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018)

questions.explanation: In Justice K. S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India (2017), a unanimous 9-judge Constitution Bench held that Privacy is protected under Article 21 and Part III.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under Article 51A of the Indian Constitution, how many Fundamental Duties are currently enshrined for every Indian citizen?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 51ಎ ವಿಧಿಯ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಭಾರತೀಯ ನಾಗರಿಕನಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಗಳಿವೆ?
questions.explanation: Originally 10 Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976; the 11th duty (education for children 6-14 yrs) was added by the 86th Amendment in 2002.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Who participates in the Electoral College for the election of the President of India under Article 54?
questions.text_alt: 54 ನೇ ವಿಧಿಯ ಅನ್ವಯ ಭಾರತದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿಗಳ ಚುನಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಚುನಾವಣಾ ಗಣದಲ್ಲಿ (Electoral College) ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವವರು ಯಾರು?

options.label: A
options.text: Elected members of both Houses of Parliament and elected members of State Legislative Assemblies

options.label: B
options.text: All members of Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and Legislative Councils

options.label: C
options.text: Elected members of Lok Sabha only

options.label: D
options.text: Governors of all States and Union Cabinet Ministers

questions.explanation: Article 54 provides that the Electoral College consists of elected members of Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and Legislative Assemblies of States, including Delhi and Puducherry.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 inserted which Schedule into the Indian Constitution containing 29 functional items for Panchayati Raj institutions?
questions.text_alt: 1992 ರ 73 ನೇ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆಯು ಪಂಚಾಯತ್ ರಾಜ್ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ 29 ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಯಾವ ಅನುಸೂಚಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂವಿಧಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿತು?
questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment inserted Part IX and the 11th Schedule (29 matters for Panchayats); the 74th Amendment inserted the 12th Schedule (18 matters for Municipalities).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the Gruha Lakshmi guarantee scheme in Karnataka, which category of women is strictly ineligible to receive the ₹2,000 monthly financial aid?
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಗೃಹಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹2,000 ಪಡೆಯಲು ಯಾವ ವರ್ಗದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು ಅರ್ಹರಲ್ಲ?

options.label: A
options.text: Women who are income tax payers or whose husbands file income tax/GST

questions.explanation: Women heads of households (or their spouses) who pay Income Tax or file Goods and Services Tax (GST) returns are excluded from Gruha Lakshmi benefits.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Shakti scheme launched by the Government of Karnataka grants free bus travel to domicile women across all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.text_alt: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಯಾವ ಬಸ್ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ?

options.label: A
