options.text: KSRTC Rajahamsa and Airavat Club Class buses

questions.explanation: Shakti scheme covers ordinary city, suburban, and rural express buses of KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC, but excludes luxury, AC, sleeper, Rajahamsa, and Airavat coaches.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the Gruha Jyothi scheme, how is the entitlement of free domestic power calculated for an eligible household?
questions.text_alt: ಗೃಹಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ಗೃಹಬಳಕೆಯ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಅರ್ಹತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಲೆಕ್ಕಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: Average monthly consumption of previous 12 months + 10% buffer, subject to a maximum cap of 200 units

options.label: B
options.text: Flat 300 units for every consumer irrespective of past usage

options.label: C
options.text: 100 units for urban areas and 50 units for rural areas

options.label: D
options.text: Calculated on number of family members multiplied by 20 units

questions.explanation: Gruha Jyothi entitles domestic consumers to free electricity calculated as their average monthly usage over the previous fiscal year plus a 10% buffer, capped at 200 units/month.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the Anna Bhagya scheme, when physical rice procurement was constrained, what cash DBT rate per kilogram was transferred directly to BPL beneficiaries in lieu of the additional 5 kg rice?
questions.text_alt: ಅನ್ನಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಕೊರತೆ ಉಂಟಾದಾಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ 5 ಕೆಜಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಗದು ಡಿಬಿಟಿ ಜಮೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: The Karnataka government initiated direct cash transfer of ₹170 per person per month (at ₹34/kg for 5 kg) into the bank accounts of BPL cardholders.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What is the maximum duration for which an eligible unemployed degree holder can receive the ₹3,000 monthly allowance under the Yuva Nidhi scheme?
questions.text_alt: ಯುವನಿಧಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಪದವೀಧರರು ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಎಷ್ಟು ಅವಧಿಯವರೆಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹3,000 ಭತ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: 2 years (or until employment is secured, whichever is earlier)

questions.explanation: Yuva Nidhi is tenable for a maximum period of 2 years from the date of enrollment or until the beneficiary secures employment/self-employment.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS 2023) enforced on 1 July 2024, the colonial offense of 'Sedition' (Section 124A of IPC) was repealed and replaced by Section 152 penalizing:
questions.text_alt: 2024 ರ ಜುಲೈ 1 ರಿಂದ ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಭಾರತೀಯ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಂಹಿತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ (ಬಿಎನ್‌ಎಸ್) ರಾಜದ್ರೋಹವನ್ನು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿ 152 ನೇ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಕೃತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಾರ್ಹಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: Acts endangering sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India

questions.explanation: Section 152 of BNS penalizes acts endangering the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India, eliminating the colonial term 'sedition' and protecting legitimate speech.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which landmark procedural reform has been codified under Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS 2023), allowing citizens to lodge complaints at any police station irrespective of jurisdiction?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತೀಯ ನಾಗರಿಕ ಸುರಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಹಿತೆಯಡಿ (ಬಿಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್) ಯಾವುದೇ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಠಾಣೆಯಲ್ಲೂ ನ್ಯಾಯವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಹಂಗಿಲ್ಲದೆ ದೂರು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿದ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: BNSS 2023 formally mandates 'Zero FIR', requiring police to register an FIR for cognizable offenses anywhere and subsequently transfer it to the jurisdictional station.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023, widely known as Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, provides what percentage of reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
questions.text_alt: ನಾರಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ವಂದನ್ ಅಧಿನಿಯಮ (106 ನೇ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2023) ಲೋಕಸಭೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಸಭೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: The 106th Amendment reserves 33% (one-third) of seats for women in Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and NCT of Delhi, effective after census and delimitation.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Who headed the High-Level Committee on 'One Nation, One Election' that submitted its recommendations to the President of India in March 2024?
questions.text_alt: 2024 ರ ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ವರದಿಯನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ 'ಒಂದು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ, ಒಂದು ಚುನಾವಣೆ' ಉನ್ನತ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಸಮಿತಿಯ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರು ಯಾರು?

options.label: A
options.text: Shri Ram Nath Kovind (Former President of India)

questions.explanation: Former President of India Ram Nath Kovind chaired the 8-member High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections recommending a two-phase synchronization.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission constituted by the President of India under Article 280?
questions.text_alt: 280 ನೇ ವಿಧಿಯಡಿ ರಚಿಸಲಾದ 16 ನೇ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಆಯೋಗದ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗಿ ನೇಮಕಗೊಂಡ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Dr. Arvind Panagariya (former Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog) was appointed Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission for the award period 2026–2031.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What official name was designated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the lunar south pole touchdown location of Chandrayaan-3's Vikram Lander?
questions.text_alt: ಚಂದ್ರಯಾನ-3 ರ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ಲ್ಯಾಂಡರ್ ಇಳಿದ ಚಂದ್ರನ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಧ್ರುವದ ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿಯವರು ನೀಡಿದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಹೆಸರೇನು?
questions.explanation: The Chandrayaan-3 landing site was named 'Shiv Shakti Point', while the Chandrayaan-2 impact spot was named 'Tiranga Point'; August 23 is National Space Day.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: India's first dedicated solar observatory satellite Aditya-L1 was successfully placed into halo orbit around which point located ~1.5 million km from Earth?
questions.text_alt: ಭೂಮಿಯಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು 15 ಲಕ್ಷ ಕಿ.ಮೀ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯಾವ ಹಾಲೋ ಕಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಸೌರ ವೀಕ್ಷಣಾಲಯ ಆದಿತ್ಯ-ಎಲ್1 ನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Aditya-L1 was placed in a halo orbit around Lagrangian Point 1 (L1) on 6 January 2024, enabling unhindered 24/7 continuous view of the Sun.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which Indian Air Force test pilot, among the four designated Gaganyaan astronaut-elects, was chosen to fly to the International Space Station (ISS) on the Axiom-4 mission?
questions.text_alt: ಗಗನ್‌ಯಾನ್‌ನ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗಗನಯಾತ್ರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಆಕ್ಸಿಯಂ-4 ಮಿಷನ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಬಾಹ್ಯಾಕಾಶ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ (ಐಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್) ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಸಲು ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾದ ಐಎಎಫ್ ಪೈಲಟ್ ಯಾರು?
questions.explanation: Wing Commander Shubhanshu Shukla was selected as prime astronaut for the joint Indo-US Axiom-4 commercial mission to the International Space Station.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Who among the following agricultural scientists was posthumously conferred the Bharat Ratna in 2024 for pioneering India's Green Revolution?
questions.text_alt: 2024 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಹಸಿರು ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯ ಹರಿಕಾರರಾದ ಯಾವ ಕೃಷಿ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮರಣೋತ್ತರವಾಗಿ 'ಭಾರತ ರತ್ನ' ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿ ಗೌರವಿಸಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Dr. M. S. Swaminathan was posthumously conferred the Bharat Ratna in 2024 alongside Karpoori Thakur, P. V. Narasimha Rao, Chaudhary Charan Singh, and L. K. Advani.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The 58th Jnanpith Award (for 2023) was jointly conferred upon celebrated Urdu poet Gulzar and which eminent Sanskrit scholar?
questions.text_alt: 58 ನೇ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಉರ್ದು ಕವಿ ಗುಲ್ಜಾರ್ ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರಿಗೆ ಜಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ನೀಡಲಾಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: The 58th Jnanpith Award was jointly awarded to renowned lyricist/filmmaker Gulzar (Urdu) and Sanskrit polymath Jagadguru Rambhadracharya.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳು ಎರಡು: ಅನುಸ್ವಾರ (o) ಮತ್ತು ವಿಸರ್ಗ (:). ಇವು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಉಚ್ಚಾರವಾಗದೆ ಸ್ವರದ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಉಚ್ಚಾರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಹ್ರಸ್ವ ಸ್ವರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: ಒಂದು ಮಾತ್ರಾ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಲಾಗುವ ಸ್ವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಹ್ರಸ್ವ ಸ್ವರಗಳೆನ್ನುವರು. ಅವು ೬: ಅ, ಇ, ಉ, ಋ, ಎ, ಒ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ವರ್ಗೀಯ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: ಕ-ವರ್ಗದಿಂದ ಮ-ವರ್ಗದವರೆಗೆ ಇರುವ ೨೫ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಗೀಯ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ಊರಲ್ಲಿ' (ಊರು + ಅಲ್ಲಿ) - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಊರು (ಉ) + ಅಲ್ಲಿ (ಅ) = ಊರಲ್ಲಿ. ಪೂರ್ವಪದದ ಅಂತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಉ' ಸ್ವರವು ಲೋಪವಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಲೋಪ ಸಂಧಿ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಮನೆಯನ್ನು' (ಮನೆ + ಅನ್ನು) - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಮನೆ (ಎ) + ಅನ್ನು = ಮನೆಯನ್ನು. ಪೂರ್ವಪದದ ಅಂತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎ/ಏ/ಐ ಸ್ವರಗಳಿದ್ದು ಉತ್ತರಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವರ ಪರವಾದಾಗ 'ಯ್' ಆಗಮವಾಗುವುದು ಯಕಾರಾಗಮ ಸಂಧಿ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ಮಳೆಗಾಲ' (ಮಳೆ + ಕಾಲ) - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಕಾರ್ಯ ನಡೆದಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಉತ್ತರಪದದ ಆದಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕ, ತ, ಪ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಗ, ದ, ಬ ಗಳು ಆದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬರುವುದು ಆದೇಶ ಸಂಧಿ (ಕಾಲ $	o$ ಗಾಲ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ದೇವೇಂದ್ರ' (ದೇವ + ಇಂದ್ರ) - ಈ ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಅ/ಆ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಇ/ಈ ಕಾರಗಳು ಪರವಾದಾಗ 'ಏ' ಕಾರ ಬರುವುದು ಗುಣ ಸಂಧಿ (ದೇವ + ಇಂದ್ರ = ದೇವೇಂದ್ರ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಏಕೈಕ' (ಏಕ + ಏಕ) - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಅ/ಆ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಏ/ಐ ಕಾರಗಳು ಪರವಾದಾಗ 'ಐ' ಕಾರವೂ, ಓ/ಔ ಪರವಾದಾಗ 'ಔ' ಕಾರವೂ ಬರುವುದು ವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸಂಧಿ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಪ್ರತ್ಯುತ್ತರ' (ಪ್ರತಿ + ಉತ್ತರ) - ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಇ, ಈ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ಯಸ್ವರ ಪರವಾದಾಗ 'ಯ್' ಕಾರ ಬರುವುದು ಯಣ್ ಸಂಧಿ (ಪ್ರತಿ + ಉತ್ತರ = ಪ್ರತ್ಯುತ್ತರ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸ' (ವಿದ್ಯಾ + ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ) - ಈ ಪದವು ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ?
questions.explanation: ಸವರ್ಣ ಸ್ವರಗಳು ಪರವಾದಾಗ ಅದೇ ಜಾತಿಯ ದೀರ್ಘ ಸ್ವರ ಬರುವುದು ಸವರ್ಣದೀರ್ಘ ಸಂಧಿ (ವಿದ್ಯಾ + ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ = ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಬೆಟ್ಟಾವರೆ' (ಬೆಟ್ಟದ + ತಾವರೆ) - ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಉತ್ತರಪದದ ಅರ್ಥವು ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸವೇ ತತ್ಪುರುಷ ಸಮಾಸ (ಬೆಟ್ಟದ + ತಾವರೆ = ಬೆಟ್ಟಾವರೆ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ಹೆಜ್ಜೇನು' (ಹಿರಿದು + ಜೇನು) - ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ವಿಶೇಷಣವಾಗಿಯೂ, ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ವಿಶೇಷ್ಯವಾಗಿಯೂ ಇರುವ ಸಮಾಸವು ಕರ್ಮಧಾರಯ ಸಮಾಸ (ಹಿರಿದು + ಜೇನು = ಹೆಜ್ಜೇನು).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಮುಲ್ಲೋಕ' (ಮೂರು + ಲೋಕ) - ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾವಾಚಕವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾವಾಚಕವಾಗಿದ್ದು ನಾಮಪದದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿ ಆಗುವ ಸಮಾಸವೇ ದ್ವಿಗು ಸಮಾಸ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ಮುಕ್ಕಣ್ಣ' (ಮೂರು ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳುಳ್ಳವನು - ಶಿವ) - ಅನ್ಯಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಸಮಸ್ತಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪದಗಳ ಅರ್ಥವಲ್ಲದೆ ಬೇರೊಂದು ಅನ್ಯಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದು ಬಹುಬ್ರೀಹಿ ಸಮಾಸ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಗಿಡಮರಬಳ್ಳಿಗಳು' - ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪದಗಳ ಅರ್ಥವೂ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಉಭಯಪದಗಳ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪದಗಳ ಅರ್ಥವು ಸಮಾನ ಪ್ರಾಧಾನ್ಯ ಪಡೆದಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸವೇ ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಸಮಾಸ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಅಕ್ಕಲ್ಲು' (ಆ + ಕಲ್ಲು) - ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸರ್ವನಾಮವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸರ್ವನಾಮ ಅಥವಾ ಕೃದಂತವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಗಮಕ ಸಮಾಸವೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: ಕನ್ನಡದ 'ಪಂಚಮೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ'ಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಪಂಚಮೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ 'ದೆಸೆಯಿಂದ', ಇದರ ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ ಅಪಾದಾನ (ಒಂದರಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಅಗಲುವಿಕೆ/ಬೇರ್ಪಡುವಿಕೆ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: 'ವರ್ಷ' ಎಂಬ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ತತ್ಸಮ 'ವರ್ಷ' ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ವರುಷ' (ಅಥವಾ ವರುಷಂ).

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಕಾರ್ಯ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಕಾರ್ಯ' ಪದದ ಕನ್ನಡ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ಕಜ್ಜ'.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಅರ್ಥ' ಎಂಬ ಪದಕ್ಕಿರುವ ನಾನಾರ್ಥಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
questions.explanation: 'ಅರ್ಥ' ಪದವು ಧನ/ಸಂಪತ್ತು (ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ), ಕಾರಣ/ಉದ್ದೇಶ, ಹಾಗೂ ತಾತ್ಪರ್ಯ/ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಎಂಬ ನಾನಾರ್ಥಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಅಂಬರ' ಎಂಬ ಪದದ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಅಂಬರ' ಎಂದರೆ ಆಕಾಶ (ಆಕಾಶ ನೀಲಿ) ಹಾಗೂ ಬಟ್ಟೆ/ವಸ್ತ್ರ (ಪೀತಾಂಬರ) ಎಂದರ್ಥ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ' ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ' (ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಾಣುವಂತಹುದು) ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಬದ್ಧ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪದ 'ಪರೋಕ್ಷ'.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಉಪ್ಪಿಗಿಂತ ರುಚಿಯಿಲ್ಲ, ___________ ಬಂಧುವಿಲ್ಲ' - ಈ ಗಾದೆ ಮಾತಿನ ಬಿಟ್ಟ ಪದವನ್ನು ಭರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿ:
questions.explanation: ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕನ್ನಡ ಗಾದೆ: 'ಉಪ್ಪಿಗಿಂತ ರುಚಿಯಿಲ್ಲ, ತಾಯಿಗಿಂತ ಬಂಧುವಿಲ್ಲ'.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: 'ಮುಖವು ಕಮಲದಂತೆ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿದೆ' - ಈ ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಉಪಮಾನ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗೆ ಬಳಸಲಾದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ವಸ್ತು 'ಕಮಲ' ಉಪಮಾನ; ಹೋಲಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ವಸ್ತು 'ಮುಖ' ಉಪಮೇಯ; 'ಅಂತೆ' ಉಪಮಾವಾಚಕ; 'ಸುಂದರ' ಸಮಾನಧರ್ಮ.

questions.subject: General Kannada
questions.label: expected
questions.text: ಕಂದ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಾದಗಳ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮಾತ್ರಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: ಕಂದ ಪದ್ಯದ ೧ ಮತ್ತು ೩ ನೇ ಪಾದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಲಾ ೧೨ ಮಾತ್ರಾಗಳು (೩ ಚತುರ್ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು), ೨ ಮತ್ತು ೪ ನೇ ಪಾದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಲಾ ೨೦ ಮಾತ್ರಾಗಳು (೫ ಚತುರ್ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು) ಒಟ್ಟು ೬೪ ಮಾತ್ರಾಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Neither the teacher nor the students _______ present in the laboratory yesterday.
questions.explanation: When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('the students', plural), hence 'were'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: If she _______ studied diligently, she would have passed the teacher recruitment examination.
questions.explanation: Third conditional structure requires 'If + past perfect (had + V3), ... would have + V3'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Convert into Passive Voice: 'The committee has submitted the evaluation report.'

options.label: A
options.text: The evaluation report has been submitted by the committee.

options.label: B
options.text: The evaluation report had been submitted by the committee.

options.label: C
options.text: The evaluation report was submitted by the committee.

options.label: D
options.text: The evaluation report is submitted by the committee.

questions.explanation: Present perfect active ('has submitted') changes to passive with 'has been submitted'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Convert into Indirect Speech: He said, 'I am working on my lesson plan.'

options.label: A
options.text: He said that he was working on his lesson plan.

options.label: B
options.text: He said that I am working on my lesson plan.

options.label: C
options.text: He told that he is working on his lesson plan.

options.label: D
options.text: He said that he had been working on his lesson plan.

questions.explanation: Present continuous ('am working') shifts to past continuous ('was working') in reported speech.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The headmaster is very proud _______ his school's academic achievements.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'proud' takes the fixed preposition 'of' ('proud of something').

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Choose the correct article: 'He is _______ European scholar visiting our university.'
questions.explanation: 'European' begins with the consonant sound /j/ (yoo-ro-pee-an), hence takes the indefinite article 'a'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What is the meaning of the idiom 'To burn the candle at both ends'?

options.label: A
options.text: To work excessively hard from early morning until late night

questions.explanation: 'To burn the candle at both ends' means exhausting oneself by working early and late without rest.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Choose the synonym of the word 'METICULOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Choose the antonym of the word 'OBSOLETE':
questions.explanation: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used (out of date); its antonym is 'modern' or 'current'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Identify the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: 'Accommodation' is spelled with double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Find the error in: 'Each of the girls (A) / have brought (B) / their homework (C) / No error (D)'

options.label: A
options.text: Part B ('have brought' should be 'has brought')

questions.explanation: 'Each' takes a singular verb, so 'have brought' must be replaced by 'has brought'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The phrasal verb 'call off' means:
questions.explanation: 'To call off' means to cancel an event or arrangement ('The strike was called off').

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Scarcely had the teacher entered the classroom _______ the bell rang.
questions.explanation: 'Scarcely... when' and 'Hardly... when' are standard correlative conjunction pairs ('No sooner... than').

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: A person who loves and collects books is called a:
questions.explanation: A 'bibliophile' is a lover and collector of books (philatelist collects stamps; numismatist collects coins).

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Identify the figure of speech in: 'The classroom was a zoo during the lunch break.'
questions.explanation: A direct comparison equating the classroom to a zoo without 'like' or 'as' is a Metaphor.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Select the correct tag question: 'She plays the veena exceptionally well, _______?'
questions.explanation: Positive present simple with third person singular takes the negative question tag 'doesn't she?'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: He has been absent from school _______ Monday last.
questions.explanation: 'Since' denotes a specific point in past time from which an action has continued up to the present.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What is the antonym of 'BENEVOLENT'?
questions.explanation: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly; 'Malevolent' means having or showing a wish to do evil.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: 'The brave soldier fought *courageously*.'
questions.explanation: 'Courageously' modifies the verb 'fought', describing how the soldier fought, hence an Adverb.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Choose the correct collective noun: 'A _______ of wolves was spotted near the forest reserve.'
questions.explanation: Wolves assemble in a 'pack' (birds in a flock, cattle in a herd, bees in a swarm).

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?

options.label: A
options.text: One of my friends is an engineer.

options.label: B
options.text: One of my friend are an engineer.

options.label: C
options.text: One of my friends are an engineer.

options.label: D
options.text: One of my friend is an engineer.

questions.explanation: 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb: 'One of my friends is an engineer'.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What does the Latin phrase 'DE FACTO' mean?

options.label: A
options.text: In reality / in practice (whether by right or not)

questions.explanation: 'De facto' denotes existing in actual fact or practice, distinct from 'de jure' (according to law).

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The teacher told the students that oil _______ on water.
questions.explanation: Universal truths and scientific facts remain in the simple present tense even in indirect speech.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Choose the synonym of 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and sincere in expression.

questions.subject: General English
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Identify the clause type of the underlined group: 'I do not know *where he lives*.'
questions.explanation: 'Where he lives' functions as the direct object of the transitive verb 'know', hence it is a Noun clause.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: According to Jean Piaget, the cognitive ability of 'Conservation' (understanding that quantity remains unchanged despite perceptual alterations in shape) develops during which stage?
questions.text_alt: ಜೀನ್ ಪಿಯಾಜೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾದರೂ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬ 'ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣಾ' (Conservation) ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಯಾವ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಕಾಸಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Conservation and reversibility emerge during the Concrete Operational Stage (7–11 years), whereas centration dominates the Pre-operational stage.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: In Lev Vygotsky's socio-cultural theory, the gap between what a child can do independently and what they can achieve with guidance is termed:
questions.text_alt: ವೈಗೋಟ್ಸ್ಕಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಗು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಬಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿರಿಯರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರವೇನು?
questions.explanation: ZPD represents the learning sweet spot where scaffolding from a More Knowledgeable Other (MKO) facilitates mastery.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Lawrence Kohlberg's theory of moral development, universal ethical principles and conscience belong to which moral level?
questions.text_alt: ಕೊಹ್ಲ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ನೈತಿಕ ವಿಕಾಸ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ ನೈತಿಕ ತತ್ವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯ ತೀರ್ಪುಗಳು ಯಾವ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ?
questions.explanation: Stage 6 (Universal Ethical Principles) is the highest stage of Post-conventional morality, transcending social laws when laws conflict with justice.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: According to Erik Erikson's psychosocial theory, which developmental crisis characterizes adolescence (12–18 years)?
questions.text_alt: ಎರಿಕ್ ಎರಿಕ್ಸನ್ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಹದಿಹರೆಯದಲ್ಲಿ (12-18 ವರ್ಷ) ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಮಾನಸಿಕ-ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಬಿಕ್ಕಟ್ಟು ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Adolescents explore personal identity and values; failure to resolve this stage leads to role confusion and lack of direction.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences identifies eight distinct intelligences. The ability to understand others' motives and moods is called:
questions.text_alt: ಗಾರ್ಡ್ನರ್ ಬಹುಮುಖಿ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಇತರರ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು, ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಏನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: Interpersonal intelligence relates to understanding other people; Intrapersonal intelligence is self-awareness of one's own feelings and goals.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Robert Sternberg's Triarchic Theory of Intelligence, which three components constitute human intelligence?
questions.text_alt: ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಸ್ಟರ್ನ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ಅವರ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಲಾದ ಮೂರು ಅಂಶಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?
questions.explanation: Sternberg's Triarchic Theory posits Componential (Analytical), Experiential (Creative), and Contextual (Practical) intelligence.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Edward Thorndike's primary law of learning stating that responses followed by satisfaction are strengthened is known as the:
questions.text_alt: ತೃಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಬಲಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸುವ ಥಾರ್ನ್‌ಡೈಕ್ ಕಲಿಕಾ ನಿಯಮ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Law of Effect posits that behavior followed by satisfying consequences tends to be repeated, while annoying consequences weaken it.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In B. F. Skinner's Operant Conditioning, which reinforcement schedule produces the highest resistance to extinction (as seen in slot machines)?
questions.text_alt: ಸ್ಕಿನ್ನರ್ ಅವರ ಕಾರ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಭಿವರ್ತನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಷ್ಟವಾಗುವುದನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಡೆಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಬಲವರ್ಧನಾ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Variable Ratio (VR) reinforcement provides rewards after an unpredictable number of responses, yielding steady, rapid rates resistant to extinction.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Ivan Pavlov's classical conditioning demonstrated that presenting a conditioned stimulus repeatedly without the unconditioned stimulus leads to:
questions.text_alt: ಪಾವ್ಲೋವ್ ಅವರ ಅಭಿಜಾತ ಅಭಿವರ್ತನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಚೋದಕವನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಬಲವರ್ಧನೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Extinction occurs when the conditioned stimulus (bell) is repeatedly presented without the unconditioned stimulus (food), causing the response to decline.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Albert Bandura's Social Learning Theory emphasizes that learning occurs through observation and modeling. What are the four observational processes in order?
questions.text_alt: ಬಂಡೂರ ಅವರ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾದರಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಣಾ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಹಂತಗಳು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಯಾವುವು?
questions.explanation: Bandura's four observational learning sub-processes are: Attention (observing), Retention (remembering), Production/Motor Reproduction, and Motivation.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016, how many categories of disabilities are officially recognized in India?
questions.text_alt: ಅಂಗವಿಕಲರ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2016 ರ (RPwD Act) ಅನ್ವಯ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾದ ನ್ಯೂನತೆಗಳ/ಅಂಗವೈಕಲ್ಯಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: The RPwD Act 2016 expanded recognized disabilities from 7 to 21, including autism, intellectual disability, acid attack survivors, and specific learning disabilities.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: A specific learning disability primarily characterized by persistent difficulties in reading decoding, spelling, and word recognition is called:
questions.text_alt: ಓದುವಿಕೆ, ಕಾಗುಣಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರಂತರ ತೊಂದರೆ ಪಡುವ ಕಲಿಕಾ ನ್ಯೂನತೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Dyslexia affects reading decoding; Dyscalculia affects mathematical calculations; Dysgraphia impairs handwriting and fine motor transcription.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009 mandates what percentage of reservation in private unaided schools for children from disadvantaged groups?
questions.text_alt: ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಹಕ್ಕು ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2009 ರ ಕಲಂ 12(1)(c) ಅನ್ವಯ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಅನುದಾನರಹಿತ ಶಾಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗದ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಶೇಕಡಾ ಸೀಟುಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀಸಲಿಡಬೇಕು?
questions.explanation: RTE Section 12(1)(c) requires private unaided schools to admit at least 25% children from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups in Grade 1/pre-primary.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: In the revised Bloom's Taxonomy of educational objectives (Anderson & Krathwohl, 2001), what is the highest cognitive process level?
questions.text_alt: ಆ್ಯಂಡರ್ಸನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಾತ್‌ವೋಲ್ ಅವರ ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಬ್ಲೂಮ್ಸ್ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಉನ್ನತ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಜ್ಞಾನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Revised Bloom's taxonomy hierarchy (bottom to top): Remembering $\to$ Understanding $\to$ Applying $\to$ Analyzing $\to$ Evaluating $\to$ Creating.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Assessment conducted continuously during instructional teaching to diagnose learning gaps and adapt classroom pedagogy is called:
questions.text_alt: ಬೋಧನಾ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲಿಕಾ ನ್ಯೂನತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ಬೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಸುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Formative assessment ('assessment for learning') occurs during instruction to provide constructive developmental feedback.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: According to Carl Rogers' Humanistic Theory of Personality, healthy personal growth and self-actualization require:
questions.text_alt: ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ರೋಜರ್ಸ್ ಅವರ ಮಾನವತಾವಾದಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆತ್ಮಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಜ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯವಾದ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Carl Rogers highlighted that congruence and unconditional positive regard create a safe psychological environment for self-actualization.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The psychological phenomenon where previous learning hinders or interferes with the acquisition of new material is known as:
questions.text_alt: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಲಿಕೆಯು ಹೊಸ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಲು ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಾಗುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಏನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: Proactive interference occurs when old memories disrupt the retrieval of newly acquired information (e.g. typing old password instead of new).

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In psychoanalytic theory, Sigmund Freud conceptualized the moral regulator of personality acting on the 'morality principle' as the:
questions.text_alt: ಸಿಗ್ಮಂಡ್ ಫ್ರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಅವರ ಮನೋವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣಾ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ನೈತಿಕ ತತ್ವಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಭಾಗ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Id operates on pleasure principle; Ego on reality principle; Superego represents internalized moral ideals and guilt (morality principle).

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: The formula to calculate Intelligence Quotient (IQ) introduced by William Stern and standardized by Lewis Terman is:
questions.text_alt: ವಿಲಿಯಂ ಸ್ಟರ್ನ್ ನೀಡಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಟರ್ಮನ್ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿ ಲಬ್ಧಾಂಕದ (IQ) ಸೂತ್ರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: IQ = (MA / CA) × 100, where MA is Mental Age determined by standardized testing and CA is actual chronological age.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Wolfgang Köhler's famous experiments with chimpanzees (Sultan) demonstrated learning by:
questions.text_alt: ಸುಲ್ತಾನ್ ಎಂಬ ಚಿಂಪಾಂಜಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೊಹ್ಲರ್ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು ಯಾವ ಕಲಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ?
questions.explanation: Köhler's Gestalt research demonstrated Insight Learning (the 'Aha!' phenomenon), where the learner suddenly reorganizes perceptual fields to solve a problem.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Carol Gilligan criticized Lawrence Kohlberg's theory of moral development primarily on the grounds of:
questions.text_alt: ಕ್ಯಾರೊಲ್ ಗಿಲ್ಲಿಗನ್ ಕೊಹ್ಲ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ಅವರ ನೈತಿಕ ವಿಕಾಸ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವನ್ನು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಯಾವ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಟೀಕಿಸಿದರು?

options.label: A
options.text: Gender bias ignoring the feminine 'Ethic of Care'

questions.explanation: Gilligan argued Kohlberg's all-male sample overvalued abstract male 'justice' morality while neglecting female relationship-oriented 'care' morality.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: A student who attributes academic failure to 'bad luck' or an 'unfair question paper' exhibits an:
questions.text_alt: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುತ್ತೀರ್ಣನಾದಾಗ 'ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಕಠಿಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು' ಅಥವಾ 'ದುರದೃಷ್ಟ' ಎಂದು ಆರೋಪಿಸುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Julian Rotter's locus of control posits that external locus attributes outcomes to environmental forces, while internal locus attributes results to personal effort.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the RPwD Act 2016, what percentage of reservation in government jobs is provided for persons with benchmark disabilities?
questions.text_alt: RPwD ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2016 ರ ಅನ್ವಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಗವಿಕಲರಿಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?
questions.explanation: The 2016 Act increased the reservation quota in government employment from 3% to 4%, and in higher education institutions to 5%.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In diagnostic educational evaluation, a test designed to compare a student's score against a pre-established performance standard rather than other peers is a:
questions.text_alt: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಇತರ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲೇ ನಿಗದಿತ ಮಾನದಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡುವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Criterion-referenced assessment measures student performance against explicit learning objectives or criteria (e.g. achieving 75%), not peer ranks.

questions.subject: Educational Psychology
questions.label: expected
questions.text: According to David Ausubel's Meaningful Verbal Learning theory, instructional material presented prior to the learning task to bridge existing cognitive schemas with new information is called an:
questions.text_alt: ಆಸುಬೆಲ್ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಜ್ಞಾನದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಸೆಯಲು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ನೀಡುವ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನಾ ಚೌಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಏನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ?
questions.explanation: David Ausubel introduced 'Advance Organizers' (comparative or expository) to anchor new learning into existing cognitive schema hierarchically.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Which register in the Central Processing Unit (CPU) holds the memory address of the next instruction to be fetched and executed?
questions.text_alt: ಸಿಪಿಯು ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಆದೇಶವನ್ನು ತರಲು ಮೆಮೊರಿ ವಿಳಾಸವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರಿಜಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Program Counter (PC) automatically increments to hold the memory address of the next consecutive instruction to be executed.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which of the following primary storage media is non-volatile and permanently stores the basic bootstrap startup instructions (BIOS)?
questions.text_alt: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಮೂಲ ಬೂಟ್‌ಸ್ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್ (BIOS) ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಅನ್ನು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: ROM retains its stored firmware permanently even when the power is turned off (non-volatile), housing the BIOS bootstrap program.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Solid-State Drives (SSDs) are much faster than traditional Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) because they utilize:
questions.text_alt: ಹಾರ್ಡ್ ಡಿಸ್ಕ್‌ಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಎಸ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಡಿ ಗಳು ಅತಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿರಲು ಕಾರಣ ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುವ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: NAND Flash Memory chips with no moving mechanical parts

questions.explanation: SSDs use semiconductor non-volatile NAND flash memory chips, eliminating mechanical seek times and rotating latency of HDDs.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Microsoft Windows, which keyboard shortcut allows a user to lock the computer screen instantly?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಂಡೋಸ್ ಆಪರೇಟಿಂಗ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಪರದೆಯನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್ ಕೀ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Windows Key + L immediately locks the computer session; Windows Key + D toggles desktop display.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In the Linux file system hierarchy, which directory contains essential system configuration files including user passwords and network setups?
questions.text_alt: ಲಿನಕ್ಸ್ ಫೈಲ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ ಕಾನ್ಫಿಗರೇಶನ್ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The `/etc` directory in Linux contains system-wide configuration files (such as `/etc/passwd`, `/etc/network/interfaces`).

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: In Microsoft Word, what is the default keyboard shortcut to open the 'Find and Replace' dialog box?
questions.text_alt: ಮೈಕ್ರೋಸಾಫ್ಟ್ ವರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ 'ಫೈಂಡ್ ಆಂಡ್ ರಿಪ್ಲೇಸ್' ಸಂವಾದ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಲು ಬಳಸುವ ಕೀಲಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + H opens Find and Replace; Ctrl + F opens Navigation/Find; Ctrl + K inserts Hyperlink.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Microsoft Excel, what symbol is prefixed to create an absolute cell reference that does not change when copied across rows or columns?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಎಕ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾರ್ಮುಲಾವನ್ನು ಕಾಪಿ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಸೆಲ್ ವಿಳಾಸ ಬದಲಾಗದಂತೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಯಾವ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: The dollar sign (`$`) locks rows and columns to create absolute references (`$A$1`), toggleable with the F4 key.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Microsoft Excel, which function searches for a value in the leftmost column of a table and returns a value in the same row from a specified column?
questions.text_alt: ಎಂಎಸ್ ಎಕ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲ ಕಾಲಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಅದೇ ಅಡ್ಡಸಾಲಿನ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕಾಲಂನ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವ ಫಂಕ್ಷನ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: VLOOKUP (Vertical Lookup) searches for a key in column 1 of a table array and retrieves data from column index `n`.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In Microsoft PowerPoint, which feature allows consistent formatting, fonts, and logos across all slides in a presentation?
questions.text_alt: ಪವರ್ ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸ್ಲೈಡ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ಏಕರೂಪದ ಫಾಂಟ್, ಬಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಲೋಗೋ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುವ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: The Slide Master is the top slide in a hierarchy that stores information about the theme, fonts, and layout across the entire deck.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Which network topology connects all client nodes directly to a central hub or switch?
questions.text_alt: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಅಥವಾ ಹಬ್‌ಗೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುವ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಟೋಪಾಲಜಿ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: In a Star topology, all devices connect to a central controller (switch); cable failure in one node does not disrupt the rest of the network.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: How many bits are used in IPv4 and IPv6 internet addresses respectively?
questions.text_alt: IPv4 ಮತ್ತು IPv6 ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ವಿಳಾಸಗಳು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತವೆ?
questions.explanation: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long (e.g. 192.168.1.1); IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long (represented as 8 hexadecimal groups).

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The protocol responsible for translating human-readable domain names (like www.google.com) into numerical IP addresses is:
questions.text_alt: ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಹೆಸರುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಐಪಿ ವಿಳಾಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುವ ಪ್ರೋಟೋಕಾಲ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: DNS translates domain names into numerical IP addresses; DHCP dynamically assigns IP addresses to hosts.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What does the 'S' stand for in HTTPS protocol used in secure web browsing?
questions.text_alt: ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ವೆಬ್ ಬ್ರೌಸಿಂಗ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುವ HTTPS ನ 'S' ಅಕ್ಷರದ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?
questions.explanation: HTTPS stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure, encrypting HTTP traffic over Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL).

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: A cyberattack that uses deceptive emails mimicking trusted banks to trick victims into revealing sensitive passwords and OTPs is known as:
questions.text_alt: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಕಲಿ ಇಮೇಲ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ ಪಾಸ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಕದಿಯುವ ಸೈಬರ್ ವಂಚನೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Phishing is social engineering using spoofed communications to harvest credentials; Ransomware encrypts files for extortion.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Malware that encrypts a victim's files and demands payment in cryptocurrency to provide the decryption key is termed:
questions.text_alt: ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಹಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಇಡುವ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Ransomware (e.g. WannaCry) encrypts user storage and demands ransom payments in untraceable cryptocurrency.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: A security device that monitors and filters incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predefined security rules is a:
questions.text_alt: ಅನಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರವೇಶವನ್ನು ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟಲು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವ ಭದ್ರತಾ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: A Firewall acts as a security barrier filtering packets between trusted internal networks and untrusted external networks.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: How many Bytes are there in exactly One Kilobyte (1 KB) in binary computing storage?
questions.text_alt: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರದಲ್ಲಿ 1 ಕಿಲೋಬೈಟ್ (1 KB) ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಎಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: Binary storage uses powers of 2: 1 KB = $2^{10}$ = 1024 Bytes; 1 MB = $2^{20}$ Bytes; 1 GB = $2^{30}$ Bytes.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which port number is standardly used by unencrypted HyperText Transfer Protocol (HTTP)?
questions.text_alt: ಎನ್‌ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡದ ಹೆಚ್‌ಟಿಟಿಪಿ (HTTP) ಸಂವಹನಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: HTTP standardly uses Port 80; HTTPS uses Port 443; FTP uses Port 21; SMTP uses Port 25.

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: What does Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) require to verify user identity securely?
questions.text_alt: ಟು-ಫ್ಯಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಅಥೆಂಟಿಕೇಶನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (2FA) ಬಳಕೆದಾರರ ದೃಢೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವ ಎರಡು ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: Something you know (password) and something you have (OTP / authenticator token)

questions.explanation: Multi-factor authentication combines two distinct factors: knowledge (password/PIN), possession (smartphone/OTP token), or inherence (fingerprint).

questions.subject: Computer Literacy
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which wireless network standard operates on IEEE 802.11 specifications?
questions.text_alt: IEEE 802.11 ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ವೈರ್‌ಲೆಸ್ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: IEEE 802.11 specifies Wireless LAN (Wi-Fi); IEEE 802.3 specifies Ethernet; IEEE 802.15 specifies Bluetooth personal area networks.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Which of the following vitamins is water-soluble and must be regularly replenished through daily diet?
questions.text_alt: ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಗುವ ಮತ್ತು ದೈನಂದಿನ ಆಹಾರದ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿಯಮಿತವಾಗಿ ಸೇವಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ವಿಟಮಿನ್ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Vitamins B and C are water-soluble; Vitamins A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble and stored in liver and adipose tissue.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Bleeding gums, delayed wound healing, and painful joints are hallmark clinical symptoms of which deficiency disease?
questions.text_alt: ವಸಡಿನಿಂದ ರಕ್ತ ಸುರಿಯುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಗಾಯಗಳು ಬೇಗ ಗುಣವಾಗದಿರುವುದು ಯಾವ ಕೊರತೆಯ ಲಕ್ಷಣ?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by Vitamin C deficiency, which impairs collagen synthesis essential for blood vessels and connective tissues.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Nutritional anemia commonly observed among adolescent school girls in India is primarily caused by dietary deficiency of:
questions.text_alt: ಹದಿಹರೆಯದ ಶಾಲಾ ಬಾಲಕಿಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುವ ರಕ್ತಹೀನತೆಗೆ (ಅನೀಮಿಯಾ) ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರಣವಾದ ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Iron deficiency impairs hemoglobin synthesis, causing microcytic anemia, addressed under the National Iron Plus Initiative.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which of the following is a non-communicable, chronic lifestyle disease?
questions.text_alt: ಈ ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕವಲ್ಲದ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲಿಕ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Type 2 Diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular diseases are non-communicable; Tuberculosis is bacterial and Malaria is parasitic.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: In First Aid for acute muscle sprains and soft tissue sports injuries, what does the clinical acronym 'RICE' stand for?
questions.text_alt: ಕ್ರೀಡಾ ಗಾಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ನಾಯು ಉಳುಕುಗಳಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'RICE' ನ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ರೂಪವೇನು?
questions.explanation: RICE protocol minimizes swelling and pain: Rest the injured area, apply Ice packs, Compress with bandage, and Elevate above heart level.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: How is Body Mass Index (BMI) standardly calculated for physical fitness evaluation?
questions.text_alt: ದೈಹಿಕ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಬಾಡಿ ಮಾಸ್ ಇಂಡೆಕ್ಸ್ (BMI) ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ ಮಾಡುವ ಸೂತ್ರ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared (kg/m²)

options.label: B
options.text: Height in meters divided by weight in kg

options.label: C
options.text: Weight in kg multiplied by height in cm

options.label: D
options.text: Weight in pounds divided by age in years

questions.explanation: BMI = weight (kg) / [height (m)]². Normal BMI range is 18.5 to 24.9; ≥ 25 is overweight; ≥ 30 is obese.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under the PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) scheme, what is the mandatory nutritional norm per day for upper primary students (Classes 6–8)?
questions.text_alt: ಪಿಎಂ ಪೋಷಣ್ (ಬಿಸಿಯೂಟ) ಯೋಜನೆಯಡಿ 6-8 ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯ ಹಿರಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಲಾದ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕಾಂಶದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವೆಷ್ಟು?
questions.explanation: PM POSHAN prescribes: Primary (Classes 1–5): 450 calories and 12g protein; Upper Primary (Classes 6–8): 700 calories and 20g protein.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which chemical compound is standardly added in drinking water treatment to destroy pathogenic bacteria through chlorination?
questions.text_alt: ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಗಾಣುಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಲು ಜಲ ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುವ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Chlorine (or calcium hypochlorite/bleaching powder) is the primary disinfectant killing waterborne pathogens.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Goitre, characterized by enlargement of the thyroid gland in the neck, is caused by nutritional deficiency of:
questions.text_alt: ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ ಊದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಗಳಗಂಡ (Goitre) ರೋಗವು ಯಾವ ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶದ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes hypothyroid enlargement (Goitre) and mental retardation; combated through iodized salt.

questions.subject: Health Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) performed on an unresponsive non-breathing individual follows which recommended ratio of chest compressions to rescue breaths?
questions.text_alt: ಉಸಿರಾಟ ನಿಂತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಿಪಿಆರ್ (CPR) ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಎದೆ ಒತ್ತಡ (Chest Compressions) ಮತ್ತು ಕೃತಕ ಉಸಿರಾಟದ ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಅನುಪಾತ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Standard CPR protocol (American Heart Association & Red Cross) recommends 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths at 100–120 bpm.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Article 51A(h) of the Constitution of India identifies which of the following as a Fundamental Duty of every Indian citizen?
questions.text_alt: ಭಾರತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ 51ಎ(ಹೆಚ್) ವಿಧಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ನಾಗರಿಕನ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform

questions.explanation: Article 51A(h) enjoins citizens 'to develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform'.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Code of Professional Ethics for School Teachers formulated by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) requires teachers to:
questions.text_alt: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿಯು (NCTE) ರೂಪಿಸಿದ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ನೀತಿ ಸಂಹಿತೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಪಾಲಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Treat all students with equality, respect, and zero discrimination on caste, creed, or gender

options.label: B
options.text: Compel students to attend private tuitions

options.label: D
options.text: Use physical force to maintain discipline

questions.explanation: NCTE professional ethics mandate equitable treatment, non-discrimination, confidentiality, and nurturing student dignity.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: PYQ
questions.text: Section 17 of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009 strictly prohibits:
questions.text_alt: ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಹಕ್ಕು ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2009 ರ ಕಲಂ 17 ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಏನನ್ನು ನಿಷೇಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?

options.label: A
options.text: Physical punishment and mental harassment of children in schools

questions.explanation: Section 17 of RTE completely bans corporal punishment and mental harassment, making it a punishable disciplinary offense.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Under Section 19 of the POCSO Act (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012), what is the legal obligation of a school teacher who suspects child sexual abuse?
questions.text_alt: ಪೋಕ್ಸೋ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 2012 ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 19 ರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಶಾಲಾ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ದೌರ್ಜನ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಿಳಿದಾಗ ಅವರ ಕಾನೂನುಬದ್ಧ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯವೇನು?

options.label: A
options.text: Mandatory reporting immediately to the Special Juvenile Police Unit or local police

options.label: B
options.text: Keep the matter confidential without informing authorities

options.label: C
options.text: Settle the dispute informally with parents

options.label: D
options.text: Wait until the end of the academic year

questions.explanation: Section 19 mandates immediate reporting of suspected child abuse; failure to report is a cognizable punishable offense under Section 21.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The famous Appiko environmental conservation movement in Karnataka, inspired by the Himalayan Chipko movement, was launched in 1983 in which district?
questions.text_alt: 1983 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಮಾಲಯದ ಚಿಪ್ಕೋ ಚಳವಳಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಿತಗೊಂಡು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ 'ಅಪ್ಪಿಕೋ ಚಳವಳಿ' ಯಾವ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು?
questions.explanation: Pandurang Hegde led the Appiko movement in Uttara Kannada district in September 1983 to embrace and protect Western Ghats forests from logging.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which core value involves putting oneself in another person's shoes and understanding their feelings from their perspective?
questions.text_alt: ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಅವರ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ಉನ್ನತ ನೈತಿಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: Empathy is cognitive and affective understanding of another's lived experience, deeper than sympathy (which is merely feeling pity).

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Which philosophy of value education advocates that values are best caught through teacher modeling and school climate rather than rote textbook lectures?
questions.text_alt: ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಾಯಿಪಾಠ ಮಾಡುವ ಬದಲು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಆದರ್ಶ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಲಾ ವಾತಾವರಣದ ಮೂಲಕ ಮೈಗೂಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸುವ ತತ್ವ ಯಾವುದು?
questions.explanation: 'Values are caught, not taught' emphasizes experiential learning, teacher modeling, restorative justice, and an inclusive school culture.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Gender sensitization in school classrooms is best promoted by:
questions.text_alt: ಶಾಲಾ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಲಿಂಗ ಸಂವೇದನೆಯನ್ನು (Gender Sensitization) ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುವ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ವಿಧಾನ ಯಾವುದು?

options.label: A
options.text: Assigning sports, leadership, and tasks equally to boys and girls without gender stereotypes

options.label: B
options.text: Assigning cleaning only to girls and heavy lifting only to boys

options.label: C
options.text: Segregating seating in all academic activities

questions.explanation: Gender equity deconstructs stereotypes by ensuring equal opportunity in leadership, participation, sports, and collaborative learning.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on which historic date observed annually as Human Rights Day?
questions.text_alt: ವಿಶ್ವ ಮಾನವ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ದಿನವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿವರ್ಷ ಯಾವ ದಿನಾಂಕದಂದು ಆಚರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
questions.explanation: The UN General Assembly adopted the UDHR on 10 December 1948 in Paris, observed worldwide as International Human Rights Day.

questions.subject: Value Education
questions.label: expected
questions.text: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar emphasized that political democracy cannot last unless there lies at the base of it:
questions.text_alt: ಡಾ. ಬಿ. ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವವು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯಲು ಅದರ ತಳಹದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದು ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದರು?

options.label: A
options.text: Social Democracy recognizing liberty, equality, and fraternity as principles of life

questions.explanation: Dr. Ambedkar stated: 'Political democracy cannot last unless there lies at the base of it social democracy, which recognizes liberty, equality and fraternity as a trinity'.

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: The classical computer architecture based on the stored-program concept where instructions and data share the same physical memory is known as:
questions.explanation: Von Neumann architecture features a shared memory system for program instructions and data, communicating via a common bus.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What is the key structural difference between Harvard Architecture and Von Neumann Architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: Harvard has separate physical memories and buses for instructions and data

options.label: B
options.text: Harvard lacks an Arithmetic Logic Unit

options.label: C
options.text: Von Neumann architecture has no Program Counter

questions.explanation: Harvard architecture physically separates instruction storage and data storage, allowing simultaneous memory access.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What is the hexadecimal representation of the binary number (110101111011)2?
questions.explanation: Grouping in 4-bit nibbles: 1101 = D (13), 0111 = 7, 1011 = B (11). Thus (D7B)16.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What is the 2's complement representation of -25 in an 8-bit signed register?
questions.explanation: +25 = 00011001. 1's complement = 11100110. Adding 1 gives 2's complement = 11100111.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: In IEEE 754 Single-Precision Floating-Point standard (32 bits), how many bits are allocated for Sign, Exponent, and Mantissa respectively?

options.label: A
options.text: 1 bit sign, 8 bits exponent, 23 bits mantissa

options.label: B
options.text: 1 bit sign, 11 bits exponent, 20 bits mantissa

options.label: C
options.text: 1 bit sign, 7 bits exponent, 24 bits mantissa

options.label: D
options.text: 2 bits sign, 8 bits exponent, 22 bits mantissa

questions.explanation: Single-precision (32-bit) IEEE 754 uses 1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits (bias 127), and 23 normalized fraction/mantissa bits.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: A computer system has a cache access time of 2 ns and main memory access time of 50 ns. If the cache hit ratio is 0.95, what is the Average Memory Access Time (AMAT)?
questions.explanation: In hierarchical memory where cache is checked first (hit time = 2 ns) and on miss main memory is accessed (miss penalty = 50 ns): AMAT = Hit Time + (Miss Rate * Miss Penalty) = 2 + (0.05 * 50) = 2 + 2.5 = 4.5 ns.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: Which electronic component characterized Second Generation computers (1956–1963)?
questions.explanation: 1st Gen: Vacuum tubes; 2nd Gen: Transistors; 3rd Gen: ICs; 4th Gen: VLSI microprocessors; 5th Gen: AI/ULSI.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What type of ROM can be erased by exposing it to ultraviolet (UV) light?
questions.explanation: Erasable Programmable ROM (EPROM) features a quartz window through which UV light erases data.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What is the decimal equivalent of the octal number (345)8?
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: Which cache mapping scheme allows a block of main memory to be loaded into ANY cache line?
questions.explanation: Fully Associative mapping permits placement into any free cache slot, eliminating conflict misses at the cost of associative hardware search.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: Which of the following is considered system software?
questions.explanation: Operating systems, device drivers, compilers, linkers, and loaders are all classifications of system software.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: Which code is an unweighted, non-reflective error-minimizing code where adjacent numbers differ by only a single bit?
questions.explanation: Gray code (reflected binary code) changes only one bit between consecutive values, eliminating transition glitches in Karnaugh maps and encoders.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: Static RAM (SRAM) cells store binary bits using which circuit element?
questions.explanation: SRAM uses cross-coupled inverters/flip-flops (typically 6 transistors per cell) and does not require periodic refresh, unlike DRAM.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What is the range of signed integers that can be represented using an 8-bit register in 2's complement format?
questions.explanation: For an n-bit 2's complement register, range is -2^(n-1) to +2^(n-1) - 1. For n=8: -128 to +127.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Fundamentals of Computers
questions.text: What does RAID Level 1 accomplish in storage architecture?
questions.explanation: RAID 1 provides redundancy by duplicating (mirroring) all data from one drive onto a secondary drive.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: If a finite set A contains n elements, what is the cardinality of its Power Set P(A)?
questions.explanation: The power set contains all possible subsets of A. If |A| = n, then |P(A)| = 2^n.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: A binary relation R on set A is defined as an Equivalence Relation if and only if R satisfies which three properties?
questions.explanation: An equivalence relation is Reflexive (aRa), Symmetric (aRb -> bRa), and Transitive (aRb & bRc -> aRc).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: The compound proposition (P -> Q) is logically equivalent to which Boolean expression?
questions.explanation: By truth table, P -> Q is false only when P is true and Q is false. Hence P -> Q == ~P v Q.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: According to De Morgan's Laws in propositional logic, ~(P ^ Q) is equivalent to:
questions.explanation: De Morgan's Law states: ~(P ^ Q) == ~P v ~Q, and ~(P v Q) == ~P ^ ~Q.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: A proposition that evaluates to TRUE under all possible truth assignments of its constituent variables is called a:
questions.explanation: A statement that is universally true in all interpretations is a Tautology.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: According to the Handshaking Lemma in Graph Theory, the sum of degrees of all vertices in an undirected graph G = (V, E) equals:
questions.explanation: Each edge contributes 1 to the degree of two endpoints, so sum(deg(v)) = 2 * |E|.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: A connected undirected graph contains an Eulerian Circuit if and only if:

options.label: A
options.text: Every vertex has an even degree

options.label: B
options.text: Exactly two vertices have odd degree

questions.explanation: Euler's Theorem: A connected graph has an Euler circuit iff every vertex has an even degree.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: How many edges are present in a tree with n vertices?
questions.explanation: A tree with n vertices is a minimally connected acyclic graph having exactly n - 1 edges.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: How many edges exist in a Complete Graph Kn having n vertices?
questions.explanation: Every vertex connects to all other n-1 vertices: (n * (n - 1)) / 2 edges.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: According to the Pigeonhole Principle, if 13 people are present in a room, what is the minimum number of people who MUST share the same birth month?
questions.explanation: With 13 pigeons and 12 pigeonholes (months), ceil(13 / 12) = 2 people must share a birth month.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: A Partially Ordered Set (Poset) is defined by a relation that is:
questions.explanation: A partial order is Reflexive, Anti-symmetric (if aRb and bRa then a = b), and Transitive.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: In Euler's formula for a planar connected graph G with V vertices, E edges, and R regions (faces), which relation holds?
questions.explanation: Euler's planar graph formula states: V - E + R = 2.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: What is the contrapositive of the conditional statement 'If it rains, then the ground is wet'?

options.label: A
options.text: If the ground is not wet, then it does not rain

options.label: B
options.text: If it does not rain, then the ground is not wet

options.label: C
options.text: If the ground is wet, then it rains

options.label: D
options.text: It rains and the ground is not wet

questions.explanation: Contrapositive of P -> Q is ~Q -> ~P, which is logically equivalent to the original statement.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: If set A has 3 elements and set B has 4 elements, how many distinct functions can be mapped from A to B?
questions.explanation: The number of functions from set A (|A| = m) to set B (|B| = n) is n^m. Here 4^3 = 64.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Discrete Structures
questions.text: What is the chromatic number of a bipartite graph with at least one edge?
questions.explanation: A graph is bipartite if and only if its vertices can be partitioned into two independent sets, meaning its chromatic number is 2.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: How many 2-input NAND gates are required to implement a 2-input XOR gate?
questions.explanation: A 2-input XOR gate requires exactly 4 NAND gates (or 5 NOR gates).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In a Karnaugh Map (K-Map), adjacent cells differ by only a single literal because the coordinates follow which code sequence?
questions.explanation: K-maps use Gray code (00, 01, 11, 10) so adjacent horizontal and vertical cells differ by exactly 1 variable bit.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: What is the Boolean expression for the Carry Output (Cout) of a Full Adder with inputs A, B, and Cin?
questions.explanation: Cout = AB + BCin + ACin (or AB + Cin(A ^ B)).
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In Morris Mano's Basic Computer architecture, what are the bit-widths of the Program Counter (PC) and the Address Register (AR) respectively?
questions.explanation: The basic computer has a 4096-word memory (4096 = 2^12), requiring 12-bit addresses. Both PC and AR are 12 bits.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In Morris Mano's instruction format, what does bit 15 (I) signify?

options.label: A
options.text: I = 0 indicates Direct Address; I = 1 indicates Indirect Address

options.label: B
options.text: I = 0 indicates Indirect Address; I = 1 indicates Direct Address

questions.explanation: Bit 15 is the mode bit: I = 0 designates direct addressing, I = 1 designates indirect addressing.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: During which timing signal of the Morris Mano instruction cycle is the instruction fetched from memory into the Instruction Register (IR)?
questions.explanation: At T0: AR <- PC. At T1: IR <- M[AR], PC <- PC + 1 (Fetch phase).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: What is the condition that causes the Race-Around Condition in a level-triggered JK flip-flop?

options.label: A
options.text: J = 1, K = 1, and clock pulse duration tp > propagation delay delta_t

questions.explanation: When J = 1, K = 1 and clock width exceeds flip-flop propagation delay, output continuously toggles unpredictably.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: Which flip-flop configuration is standardly used to eliminate the JK race-around condition?
questions.explanation: Master-Slave flip-flop isolates input from output: master updates on clock pulse leading edge, slave transfers to output on trailing edge.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In which addressing mode is the operand address calculated as Effective Address = PC + Address Field Offset?
questions.explanation: Relative addressing computes EA = PC + displacement, ideal for position-independent branching.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: What is the primary architectural advantage of a Microprogrammed Control Unit over a Hardwired Control Unit?

options.label: B
options.text: High flexibility and ease of modifying instruction set via control memory microcode

questions.explanation: Microprogrammed units store control words in ROM; updating or adding instructions requires only updating microcode without hardware rewiring.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: How many selection lines are required for a 16-to-1 Multiplexer?
questions.explanation: A 2^n to 1 MUX requires n select lines. For 16 inputs: 2^4 = 16, so 4 select lines.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: What is the characteristic equation of a T (Toggle) flip-flop?
questions.explanation: Q(next) = T XOR Q. If T = 0, state stays unchanged (0 XOR Q = Q); if T = 1, state inverts (1 XOR Q = ~Q).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In an instruction pipeline with 5 stages (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, Write-back), each having delay 10 ns, what is the theoretical maximum speedup over a non-pipelined processor for a large number of instructions?
questions.explanation: For k stages, theoretical speedup S_k = k (as n -> infinity). For 5 stages, maximum speedup is 5.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: A 3-to-8 line decoder with enable input can be directly used as a:
questions.explanation: A decoder with an enable line functions identically to a demultiplexer, routing the enable data signal to 1 of 8 output lines.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Computer Architecture
questions.text: In a computer system, Direct Memory Access (DMA) controller transfers data between I/O peripherals and main memory by:

options.label: A
options.text: Routing every byte through the CPU accumulator

options.label: B
options.text: Bypassing the CPU and taking temporary control of the system bus

questions.explanation: DMA takes control of the memory bus from the CPU to perform high-speed block transfers directly between I/O and RAM.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What is the difference between malloc() and calloc() in standard C dynamic memory allocation?

options.label: A
options.text: calloc() allocates contiguous memory and initializes all bytes to zero; malloc() leaves bytes uninitialized (garbage)

options.label: B
options.text: malloc() initializes to zero; calloc() leaves garbage

options.label: C
options.text: malloc() is in C++, calloc() is in C

questions.explanation: calloc(n, size) initializes all allocated bytes to 0; malloc(size) allocates raw bytes containing indeterminate garbage values.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In C++, what mechanism enables runtime polymorphism (dynamic binding) when a virtual function is called through a base class pointer?

options.label: B
options.text: Virtual Method Table (vtable) and virtual pointer (vptr)

questions.explanation: The compiler creates a vtable of function pointers per class and embeds an invisible vptr inside each object pointing to its class vtable.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In C++, a class that contains at least one 'Pure Virtual Function' (e.g., virtual void display() = 0;) is termed:
questions.explanation: An abstract class contains at least one pure virtual function (= 0) and cannot be directly instantiated.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: How is the 'Diamond Problem' in C++ multiple inheritance resolved to prevent duplicate base class instances in the derived object?
questions.explanation: Declaring intermediate classes with 'virtual public Base' ensures only a single shared instance of the grandparent base class is created.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What happens if a pointer in C points to dynamically allocated memory that has already been deallocated using free(ptr)?

options.label: C
options.text: It throws an immediate compile-time error

options.label: D
options.text: It converts into a Wild Pointer

questions.explanation: A pointer referencing deallocated heap memory is a Dangling Pointer; accessing it causes undefined behavior.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: Which segment of process memory stores local variables and function call activation frames?
questions.explanation: Local variables and return frames reside on the Stack (LIFO discipline).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In computer graphics, what is the key advantage of Bresenham's Line Drawing Algorithm over the DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) algorithm?

options.label: A
options.text: It utilizes only fast integer addition and subtraction, avoiding floating-point arithmetic

options.label: D
options.text: It does not require frame buffers

questions.explanation: Bresenham's algorithm avoids floating-point operations by formulating an integer decision parameter, making it vastly faster.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What is the 3x3 homogeneous transformation matrix for 2D Translation by vector (tx, ty)?
questions.explanation: In 3x3 homogeneous form: x' = x + tx, y' = y + ty, so row 1 is [1, 0, tx], row 2 is [0, 1, ty], row 3 is [0, 0, 1].
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In a Raster Scan display with resolution 1024 x 768 and 24-bit True Color depth, what is the minimum Frame Buffer size required?
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: Which line clipping algorithm tests line endpoints against a 4-bit region code (TBRL - Top, Bottom, Right, Left) to determine trivial acceptance or rejection?
questions.explanation: Cohen-Sutherland line clipping uses 4-bit outcodes for rectangular clipping window boundaries.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What does a 'Virtual Destructor' in a base class guarantee in C++?

options.label: A
options.text: Ensures derived class destructor executes first, followed by base class destructor when deleting through base pointer

options.label: B
options.text: Prevents base class from being deleted

questions.explanation: Without virtual destructors, deleting a derived object via a base pointer invokes only the base destructor, leaking derived resources.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What is the output of the C expression: sizeof('a') on a 32-bit standard C compiler?
questions.explanation: In C, character constants like 'a' are of type int (sizeof('a') == sizeof(int) == 4 bytes). In C++, they are of type char (1 byte).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: What type of display architecture directs the electron beam ONLY along the lines of the picture to be drawn?
questions.explanation: Random scan (stroke/vector) displays draw line segments directly from point to point, eliminating aliasing jaggies.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In C++, which operator CANNOT be overloaded?
questions.explanation: Operators that cannot be overloaded in C++: Scope resolution (::), Member access (.), Pointer to member (.*), and Ternary conditional (?:).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: Programming and Graphics
questions.text: In 2D transformations, reflection about the line y = 0 (X-axis) transforms point (x, y) into:
questions.explanation: Reflecting across the X-axis leaves x unchanged while inverting the sign of y: (x, -y).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: Which relational integrity constraint mandates that primary key attributes cannot contain NULL values?
questions.explanation: Entity integrity states that no primary key attribute may contain a NULL value because it uniquely identifies a relation tuple.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: A minimal super key containing no extraneous or redundant attributes is called a:
questions.explanation: A Candidate Key is by definition a minimal Super Key.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: A relation is in Second Normal Form (2NF) if and only if it is in 1NF and satisfies which condition?

options.label: A
options.text: No non-prime attribute is partially dependent on any candidate key

options.label: C
options.text: Every determinant is a super key

questions.explanation: 2NF eliminates partial dependencies: every non-prime attribute must be fully functionally dependent on the entire primary/candidate key.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: A relation R is in Third Normal Form (3NF) if for every non-trivial functional dependency X -> Y:

options.label: A
options.text: X is a Super Key OR Y is a Prime Attribute

options.label: B
options.text: X must be a Super Key only

options.label: C
options.text: Y must be a Super Key

options.label: D
options.text: X and Y are both non-prime

questions.explanation: In 3NF, for every X -> Y: either X is a super key OR Y is a prime attribute (part of some candidate key).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: What is the distinguishing criterion between 3NF and Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF)?

options.label: A
options.text: In BCNF, for every non-trivial X -> Y, X MUST strictly be a Super Key

questions.explanation: BCNF removes the second condition of 3NF: for every non-trivial X -> Y, X must strictly be a Super Key.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: A decomposition of relation R into R1 and R2 is provably LOSSLESS if and only if:

options.label: A
options.text: (R1 intersect R2) -> R1 OR (R1 intersect R2) -> R2

options.label: C
options.text: R1 and R2 share zero common attributes

options.label: D
options.text: R1 is in 3NF and R2 is in BCNF

questions.explanation: Lossless join decomposition requires the common attributes to form a super key of at least one of the decomposed relations.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: Which ACID property guarantees that all database updates made by a committed transaction persist permanently on disk even during power failure?
questions.explanation: Durability ensures committed transaction changes survive system crashes (enforced by Write-Ahead Logging / Redo logs).
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: In Two-Phase Locking (2PL) protocol, what happens during the 'Growing Phase'?

options.label: A
options.text: The transaction may acquire locks, but cannot release any lock

options.label: B
options.text: The transaction may release locks, but cannot acquire locks

options.label: D
options.text: The database increases frame buffer size

questions.explanation: Phase 1 (Growing): locks acquired, none released. Phase 2 (Shrinking): locks released, none acquired.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: What additional constraint makes 'Strict 2PL' immune to Cascading Aborts (cascadeless)?

options.label: A
options.text: All exclusive (X) locks held by the transaction are retained until it commits or aborts

questions.explanation: Strict 2PL holds all Exclusive locks until commit/abort, ensuring uncommitted dirty data is never read by concurrent transactions.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.text: A concurrent transaction schedule is Conflict Serializable if and only if its Precedence (Serialization) Graph contains:
